title: OPERADOR DE COS JR (234)
description:
A Iqony Solutions do Brasil é uma subsidiária da Iqony Solutions GmbH, fornecedor conhecido internacionalmente pelos serviços especializados no setor energético, atuando em mais de 80 países em todo o mundo. Desde 2002, a Iqony Solutions do Brasil, com sede no Rio de Janeiro, oferece seus serviços nas áreas de Engenharia, Consultoria e Operação & Manutenção para clientes na América do Sul em usinas de geração de energia. O grupo é proprietário de aproximadamente 7.6 GW de capacidade instalada, incluindo plantas Eólicas, Térmicas, Solar, entre outras. Ao lado do investidor, oferecemos as melhores soluções para Engenharia e Operação & Manutenção. Atualmente, a Iqony Solutions GmbH opera mais de 6 GW de terceiros e 7.6 GW de plantas próprias. A Iqony Solutions do Brasil também oferece serviços no setor de energias renováveis com contratos no Brasil que somam mais de 5 GW. A empresa também possui um Centro de Operação e Monitoramento Remoto, situado no Rio de Janeiro.

A IQONY Solutions do Brasil Ltda, assume o compromisso de atuação baseando-se na valorização e respeito aos direitos humanos, rejeitando todas as formas de discriminação, e está comprometida em promover e valorizar a diversidade, inclusão e equidade de tratamento em todos os níveis e processos da organização, zelando por um ambiente saudável e equilibrado de trabalho. Nossos processos seletivos são abertos para todas as pessoas, independente de gênero, orientação sexual, cor/raça, deficiências, religião, nacionalidade, naturalidade, idade ou quaisquer outras características pessoais.

Descrição

  • Operar sistemas de transmissão como linhas de média e alta tensão, subestações, transformadores e sistemas auxiliares;
  • Operar sistemas de geração eólicos, fotovoltaicos e hidráulicos;
  • Realizar o monitoramento, e intervenção quando necessário, de todas as unidades geradoras das plantas operadas remotamente;
  • Atender solicitação do ONS para restrição de potência ativa, controle de potência reativa, entre outros, das plantas de geração;
  • Executar manobras remotas nos equipamentos de geração e transmissão, afim de liberar os equipamentos para a equipe de manutenção;
  • Emissão de registros de ocorrências e relatórios diários;
  • Liberar e acompanhar os pedidos de Solicitação de Intervenção;

  • Curso técnico em eletrotécnica, eletrônica ou eletromecânica.

title: Senior Analytics Engineer
description:
Sobre a Lemon: as mudanças climáticas são um desafio complexo, mas as soluções não podem ser. A Lemon existe para facilitar que empresas e pessoas impactem positivamente o meio ambiente por meio de energia mais barata e limpa. Somos comprometidos com nossos clientes e com o planeta, oferecendo atendimento próximo e inovações que incentivam mudanças no setor elétrico. Somos apoiados por investidores globais em tecnologia e buscamos construir um time diverso com experiências e formações distintas para criar a nova era da energia limpa.

Sobre o time de tech: o time de Tecnologia da Lemon é o coração da nossa inovação e crescimento. Nossa tecnologia é criada e mantida por times multidisciplinares, responsáveis por desenvolver soluções escaláveis que impulsionam a nossa missão de revolucionar o setor de energia limpa. Trabalhamos em um ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo, onde a criatividade e a excelência técnica são valorizadas. Usamos Google Cloud BigQuery como data warehouse e SQL para as transformações entre as camadas do nosso lakehouse, buscando governança e qualidade de dados alinhadas ao negócio. Estamos em constante evolução e esperamos que você contribua para isso também. Se você deseja fazer parte de uma equipe de ponta e contribuir para um futuro mais sustentável, a Lemon é o lugar certo para você.

O que você vai fazer

  • Ter a oportunidade de ajudar a transformar em unicórnio uma empresa com um dos maiores potenciais do mercado brasileiro;
  • Ajudar na remodelagem do ambiente analítico da empresa, sendo referência no uso de dados e traduzindo necessidades de negócio em soluções analíticas robustas;
  • Aumentar a confiabilidade dos insights baseados em dados com boas práticas de modelagem de dados em produtos de dados fundacionais e derivados;
  • Ser responsável pelas pipelines de transformação dos dados nas diferentes camadas do nosso ambiente analítico, garantindo a qualidade dos dados entregues;
  • Ser um dos pivôs no aculturamento da empresa em Governança, Qualidade e Confiabilidade de dados;
  • Apoiar e mentorar colegas em práticas de engenharia analítica, ajudando a elevar o nível técnico do time.

O perfil que buscamos

  • Profunda mentalidade de ownership, demonstrando forte responsabilidade pelo que constrói e mantém;
  • Comunicativo, responsivo e didático, com capacidade de traduzir construções técnicas em explicações tangíveis ao negócio;
  • Colaborativo e responsável, ajudando de forma proativa seus colegas sem prejudicar seus próprios compromissos;
  • Interessado pelo negócio e com vontade de entender suas regras, características e particularidades — queremos alguém que se envolva, entenda e questione;
  • Adaptabilidade e flexibilidade para colaborar em um ambiente de constante dinamismo. Somos uma startup e tomadas de decisão rápidas e assertivas fazem parte da nossa essência.

Experiência prévia / habilidades exigidas

  • SQL avançado (otimização, CTEs, window functions);
  • Fluência em metodologias de modelagem analítica de dados (Data Vault, Kimball, Star Schema etc.);
  • Conceitos como Data Lake, Data Warehouse, Data Lakehouse, Data Mesh;
  • Fundamentos de Data Quality e suas dimensões, frameworks e estratégias de implementação;
  • Noções de BigQuery (GCP) - experiência em boas práticas e performance;
  • Versionamento de código (Git) e boas práticas no uso de esteiras de produtização (CI/CD).

Será um diferencial se você já tiver conhecimentos em

  • Programação em Python;
  • Dataform ou dbt;
  • Experiência com pipelines de ingestão de APIs, webhooks e arquivos de diferentes formatos;
  • Experiência com tratamento de dados semiestruturados;
  • Experiência com orquestradores de dados (por exemplo, Airflow).

O que a gente oferece

  • Remuneração compatível com o mercado;
  • Trabalho remoto;
  • Materiais de escritório;
  • Coworking em todo o país;
  • Cartão Caju flexível (utilizável nas categorias alimentação, refeição, mobilidade, educação, saúde e cultura);
  • Plano de saúde;
  • Plano odontológico;
  • Programa de saúde mental e bem-estar (Zenklub);
  • Wellhub (Gympass);
  • Auxílio farmácia;
  • Lemon Feriados (dias de folga adicionais próximos a feriados).

Diversidade e inclusão

Aqui na Lemon a diversidade é um compromisso ético. Somos engajados em nos tornar uma empresa cada vez mais diversa e, se você se sentir confortável, gostaríamos de saber na candidatura se se identifica/declara pertencente a algum grupo de diversidade. Encorajamos candidaturas de pessoas com diferentes histórias e vivências para um ambiente mais inclusivo.

title: Commissioned Sales Representative - LATAM Region (Remote)
description:
About Monetize More

Monetize More is a leading ad-tech company dedicated to empowering digital publishers to maximize their ad revenue through innovative technology and strategic partnerships. Our cutting-edge platform optimizes ad layouts, leverages header bidding, and integrates advanced analytics to drive superior results for publishers worldwide. Headquartered in Canada with a strong presence in the APAC region, we’re looking for a dynamic Commissioned Sales Representative to join our high-performing team and help publishers thrive in the digital advertising ecosystem.

Job Overview

As a Commissioned Sales Representative at MonetizeMore, you will be the face of our brand in the LATAM region, driving new business by identifying, engaging, and converting publisher leads into long-term clients. This role starts as a commission-only position, offering uncapped earning potential for high performers. Upon consistently meeting sales targets, you will transition to a competitive fixed salary plus commission structure, rewarding your success with stability and growth opportunities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead Generation and Prospecting: Identify and target high-potential publishers in the LATAM region through research, networking, and industry events.
  • Client Engagement: Build and maintain strong relationships with publishers, understanding their needs and presenting tailored ad-tech solutions from Monetize More.
  • Sales Conversion: Drive the full sales cycle from initial outreach to closing deals, leveraging product demos, proposals, and negotiations to secure partnerships.
  • Market Representation: Represent MonetizeMore at industry conferences, webinars, and networking events, establishing the company as a trusted leader in ad-tech.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with the account management and technical teams to ensure seamless onboarding and optimization for new clients.
  • Reporting and Analytics: Track sales performance using CRM tools, providing regular updates on pipeline progress and market insights to leadership.
  • Market Intelligence: Stay informed on LATAM ad-tech trends, competitor offerings, and publisher needs to refine sales strategies.

Qualifications

  • Experience: 2+ years of B2B sales experience, preferably in ad-tech, digital advertising, or SaaS industries.
  • Industry Knowledge: Familiarity with digital advertising concepts such as header bidding, programmatic advertising, ad optimization, and publisher monetization.
  • Skills:
    • Proven ability to generate and close leads in a competitive market.
    • Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
    • Proficiency with CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot) and sales analytics.
    • Self-motivated with a strong drive to succeed in a commission-based environment.
  • Regional Expertise: Understanding of the LATAMdigital publishing landscape, with fluency in English and preferably one additional LATAM language (Portuguese, Spanish, French).
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, or a related field (preferred but not mandatory).

Compensation Structure

  • 0–$10,000 Monthly Revenue: 10% commission.
  • $10,001–$25,000 Monthly Revenue: 12% commission.
  • $25,001–$50,000 Monthly Revenue: 15% commission.
  • $50,001+ Monthly Revenue: 18% commission.
Note: Commissions are calculated based on the revenue generated from new client acquisitions and are paid monthly.

Why Join Monetize More?

  • Innovative Environment: Work with a leading ad-tech platform that empowers publishers to succeed.
  • Uncapped Earnings: Maximize your income through a lucrative commission structure designed for high performers.
  • Career Growth: Transition to a salaried role with opportunities to advance into leadership positions.
  • Impactful Work: Help publishers in the APAC region unlock their full revenue potential with cutting-edge technology.
  • Team Culture: Join a passionate, collaborative team with a global presence and a commitment to excellence.

description:
Strategy & Operations Senior Analyst (Performance)

Rio de Janeiro - Brazil

About the company

If you see technology as a way to smooth your path in life, our team does too: Your Path, Our Journey.

We believe in technology that connects talented people who embrace diversity to create and share paths we don\'t even know about (yet!). We work to generate value not only for our users but, above all, for the communities we serve and for society as a whole, making every day better for everyone with mobility and delivery services (99) or digital payments (99Pay).

To make life easier for millions of people every day, since 2018, we have been part of DiDi DiDi Global Inc., the world’s leading mobility technology platform. We are pioneers in creating innovative solutions that start in Brazil and scale up to make a positive impact in more than 12 countries where DiDi operates. This innovation encompasses sustainability, safety, artificial intelligence, financial markets, and much more.

Whether building projects from scratch or improving our solutions, we enjoy challenges that give us butterflies, which is why we work at a fast pace with respect, collaboration, and good humor. Along this journey, we also draw strength from diverse experiences and opinions to grow together, fail quickly, learn, and adjust the course to create solutions that deliver even better results.

About the team/role

We are looking for talented professionals to join our Regional Operations team at 99Food ! This is an exciting opportunity for individuals who are highly analytical, data-driven, and eager to solve complex business challenges at the city level. If you have a start-up spirit and are always looking to create value, you would be a great fit for this team!

As part of Regional Operations , selected candidates will play a key role in driving city growth, improving marketplace performance, and shaping local strategies that connect users, restaurants, and couriers. This role requires a hands-on approach, strong problem-solving skills, and a proactive mindset to identify opportunities for growth, efficiency, and differentiation.

The ideal candidates will engage directly with restaurant partners, customers, and business development teams to understand the dynamics of each city. They will analyze local performance data, gather on-the-ground perspectives, and translate insights into actionable strategies that strengthen 99Food’s position in each market and ensure long-term sustainable growth.

In this role, you\'ll be...

As a Strategy & Operations Senior Analyst at 99Food, you will be responsible for monitoring and analyzing the performance of our marketplace, growth campaigns, and communication initiatives . Your role is critical in ensuring that strategies are not only well-designed but also effectively executed and continuously optimized.

You will take ownership of building and maintaining performance dashboards, identifying key trends, and uncovering improvement opportunities across cities. By translating data into actionable insights, you will support decision-making and help guide campaign strategy, restaurant engagement, and customer growth.

This position requires a professional who is highly analytical, detail-oriented, and structured , with strong communication skills to collaborate across Operations, Marketing, CRM, Product, and BD teams. You will act as the bridge between strategy and execution , ensuring that every initiative is measured, tracked, and improved to maximize its impact.

Your work will directly contribute to shaping how 99Food grows and strengthens its position in competitive markets, driving both short-term results and long-term expansion .

We\'re eager to be in touch because you have...

  • General Requirements
    • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Statistics, Business Administration, Economics, or related fields.
    • 2–5 years of experience in data analytics, operations, strategy, or growth-related roles.
    • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
    • Advanced Excel, SQL, and data analytics skills (Python/R knowledge is a plus, but not required).
  • Performance Management
    • Experience with campaign results analysis, including performance tracking, communication effectiveness, and financial tracking.
    • Prior experience with customer-related activities (e.g., campaign management, communication strategy, customer cohort analysis, market analysis, budget management, etc.).
    • Stakeholder and project management experience, with exposure to Operations, Product, Sales/BD, and Marketing/CRM.
    • Fluency in Portuguese and English; Mandarin is a strong plus.

You\'ll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value. We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data-driven. We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win-win Collaboration. Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone\'s best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity. Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth. We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion. Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

Diversity & Inclusion

Diversity is not a vision of the future or something we wish to have one day, it is a non-negotiable value of who we are.

We practice inclusion, plurality, and respect. And we count on the governance of the Diversity Committee, which works together with HR, leadership and identity groups - 99Adapta, 99Afro, 99Cores, 99Mulheres, and 99Mamães. This part of our journey has been written, there remains a long road before us.

We reinforce that this position is open to everyone, including pregnant people and people with disabilities (PwD).

Acronis is revolutionizing cyber protection—providing natively integrated, all-in-one solutions that monitor, control, and protect the data that businesses and lives depend on. We are looking for a Cloud Partner Success Manager to join our mission to create a #CyberFit future and protect all data, applications and systems across any environment.

As the Cloud Partner Success Manager, you will leverage your experience in Account Management with a strong focus on Data Protection and Cyber Security. You will manage a portfolio of service providers using Acronis Cyber Protect Cloud in Brazil. Your primary objectives will include driving Annual Recurrent Revenue growth through strategic account planning, fostering adoption of new services, ensuring partner retention, and delivering a best-in-class partner experience that distinguishes Acronis in the market.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Conduct territory analysis and planning for dedicated geographies to identify top potential partners, develop relationship with key decision makers on partner side and maintain a regularity/frequency of contact with every partner depending on priority
  • Align with Acronis Cloud Distributors for joint activities for channel enablement and drive quarter over quarter cloud revenue growth working through assigned partners
  • Train new and existing partners with existing and new products, support new partners on daily basis on business and technology development, and guide them through onboarding and enablement stage equipping with all needed knowledge, resources and tools
  • Perform account planning with all managed partners with level of certain details depending on partner’s engagement, loyalty and responsiveness
  • Motivate and enable partners to sell Acronis services to existing customer base of the partner, attract new customers to partner and help to retain existing customer to partner
  • Drive partner’s satisfaction and acting as a trusted advisor and single point of contact throughout the entire partner lifecycle
  • Drive successful upsell/cross sell initiatives with partner to increase new services attach rate
  • Engage and orchestrate all needed internal resources to help dedicated partners’ growth, including Presales and Technical support teams
  • Profile every managed partner on vendors and tools they sell/use putting all information into Partner Passport. Every CSP Passport should have not less than 80% fields filled out
  • Know partner’s lifecycle management and be able to lead a partner along it through a set of regular activities focused on educating, evangelizing, making committed
  • Key KPIs: Total Revenue from signed partners, churn rate (% of partners leaving the program), number of Acronis services sold through the partner

WHAT YOU BRING

  • 5+ years of sales and marketing experience in the software industry (Inside Channel Sales and Channel development position within a software vendor)
  • Fluent English and Portuguese, both written and verbal
  • Proven experience in a cyber security company demonstrating a strong understanding of industry practices and protocols is required
  • In-depth channel and field sales experience with an understanding of the cloud market business model
  • Strong presentation, communication, and planning skills
  • Strong internal customer focus with desire to learn all aspects of the business
  • High level of discipline, attention to detail, and ability to meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment while still maintaining a high-level of accuracy
  • Strong written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills
  • Outstanding organizational, problem solving, and multi-tasking skills
  • Collaborative, team-player with a commitment to succeed and never give up attitude
  • Self-motivated, proactive, and able to work with minimal supervision

WHO WE ARE

Acronis is a global cyber protection company that provides natively integrated cybersecurity, data protection, and endpoint management for managed service providers (MSPs), small and medium businesses (SMBs), enterprise IT departments and home users. Our all-in-one solutions are highly efficient and designed to identify, prevent, detect, respond, remediate, and recover from modern cyberthreats with minimal downtime, ensuring data integrity and business continuity. We offer the most comprehensive security solution on the market for MSPs with our unique ability to meet the needs of diverse and distributed IT environments.

A Swiss company founded in Singapore in 2003, Acronis offers over twenty years of innovation with 15 offices worldwide and more than 1800 employees in 50+ countries. Acronis Cyber Protect is available in 26 languages in 150 countries and is used by over 20,000 service providers to protect over 750,000 businesses.

Our corporate culture is focused on making a positive impact on the lives of each employee and the communities we serve. Mutual trust, respect and belief that we can contribute to the world everyday are the cornerstones of our team. Each member of our “A-Team” plays an instrumental role in driving the success of our innovative and expanding business. We seek individuals who excel in dynamic, global environments and have a never give up attitude, contributing to our collective growth and impact.

Our Interview Practices

To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process.

Use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during live interviews may be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process and a full criminal, education and identification background check is required for all new hires.

Acronis is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, marital status, national origin, physical or mental disability, medical condition, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances.

Join to apply for the Core+ Support Expert role at Docusign

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Company overview

Docusign brings agreements to life. Over 1.5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the #1 company in e-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).

What you’ll do

The Core+ Support Expert - eSign is the internal voice for our customer base, with accountability and responsibility to deliver on our customers’ needs. This role is the liaison between customers and all functional areas within Docusign to resolve technical support inquiries. Working with resources across Docusign, the Core+ Support Expert expedites the resolution of complex technical issues to empower customers to achieve the highest value and adoption of our software.

This position is an individual contributor role reporting to the Senior Support Service Delivery Manager.

Responsibilities

  • Support Docusign Intelligent Agreement Management (IAM) and associated services
  • Resolve escalated cases from support channels involving customer-reported issues
  • Own customer issues requiring engineering engagement to address technical bugs and influence the development roadmap
  • Apply technical product expertise within IAM areas to support customer adoption
  • Achieve Docusign Customer Support service level goals in IAM areas
  • Utilize support tools and resources, including telephone, Salesforce, Jira, Docusign logging systems, SharePoint, browser developer tools, internal admin console, SQL, and text analysis tools
  • Query languages to gather and track affected documents to further understand customer impact
  • Identify product improvements, bugs, and opportunities to enhance customer experience
  • Promote Docusign products and services through consultative discussions
  • Partner with non-delivery teams to identify training needs and develop content
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams such as Product, Engineering, and Account Management to ensure alignment

Job Designation

Remote: Employee is not required to be in or near an office frequently and works from a designated remote work location for the majority of the time. Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position\'s job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.

What you bring

Basic

  • Bachelor of Science degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical discipline
  • 2+ years of SaaS troubleshooting experience in a Technical Support capacity
  • Experience with modern markup and programming languages such as XML, C#, Python, PHP, JavaScript/jQuery, or similar tools
  • Experience with troubleshooting in a web-based environment, including HTTP, JSON, IIS, HTML, and CSS
  • Experience with log analysis using network tools such as Wireshark, Fiddler, Charles Proxy, or other browser/developer tools, or similar
  • Experience in documenting steps taken to troubleshoot problems through resolution for explanation with any audience

Preferred

  • Ability to troubleshoot regular expressions and other complex data validation rules
  • Expertise with web-based applications, web service APIs, monitoring tools (e.g., Dynatrace), and authentication technologies such as SAML and OAuth
  • Familiarity with structured query languages such as SQL and SOQL
  • Ability to maintain composure in critical situations and communicate clearly with both internal and external customers
  • Ability to collaborate with co-workers within the organization and beyond to resolve any situation for our customers
  • Familiarity with basic Docusign Contract Lifecycle and Agreement Management workflows and methodology
  • Speak another language fluently as per the advertised opportunity
  • Professional experience within relevant industries for which Docusign provides solutions
  • Can work well within a team environment as well as independently
  • Docusign organization administration work experience, or similar knowledge
  • Familiarity with JIRA and Salesforce
  • Self-motivated, goal-oriented, with exceptional organizational, writing, and time management skills
  • Demonstrated analytical and problem-solving skills, real-time troubleshooting
  • Familiarity with at least one vertical or subject matter associated with Docusign, signing or agreement products
  • Effective communication skills are a key component of this role

Life at Docusign

Working here

Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.

We each have a responsibility to ensure every team member has an equal opportunity to succeed, to be heard, to exchange ideas openly, to build lasting relationships, and to do the work of their life. Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. And for that, you’ll be loved by us, our customers, and the world in which we live.

title: Network Engineer II
description:
Overview

When you think of InComm Payments, think of Innovative Payments Technology. We were founded over 30 years ago and continue to be a pioneer in the payment (FinTech) industry. Since our inception, we have grown to be a team of over 3,000 employees in 35 countries around the world. We own over 400 global technical patents and a network that includes over 525,000 points of retail distribution that points to our industry expertise.

We are significantly growing our Engineering and IT teams in Brazil and are focused on finding talent for various financial technology (Fintech) engineering, database, development, and testing teams.

InComm Payments is highly focused on our people and their growth, and we work hard to make a career at InComm Payments meaningful and rewarding. We value innovation, quality, passion, integrity and responsibility in all that we do, and we are looking for great people to join our team as we move forward towards a very bright future. We anticipate developing future leaders for our teams in Brazil!

Benefits include health and dental insurance, meal and restaurant vouchers, fixed monthly stipend for internet and mobile expenses, InComm hardware/software, and annual bonuses! All positions are CLT.

You can learn more about InComm Payments by visiting our Website or connecting with us on LinkedIn , YouTube , Twitter , Facebook , or Instagram .


About This Opportunity

Join our lean and dynamic NOC team as a NOC Technician, where you will play a key role in maintaining the operational excellence of our network. This position is ideal for someone with a basic understanding of networking concepts and a strong willingness to learn and grow in a fast-paced, 24/7/365 environment. As part of our team, you will be responsible for monitoring alerts, managing emails and tickets, and escalating issues to ensure continuous network performance.
Given the lean nature of our NOC, flexibility is crucial. While your primary schedule will be 9 AM to 6 PM US Eastern Time, Monday through Friday, you must be open to shift changes and occasional late-night deployments to support live monitoring of our network resources during those deployments.


Responsibilities
  • Monitor network alerts using tools such as Solar Winds, Thousand Eyes, Pingdom, or Splunk.
  • Respond to emails and manage tickets in ServiceNow ITSM.
  • Escalate issues to more experienced team members when necessary.
  • Participate in shift changes and late-night deployments as needed.
  • Collaborate with team members to ensure continuous network operations and quick resolution of incidents.

Qualifications
  • 1–2 years of experience in a networking or IT support role.
  • Basic understanding of networking concepts (e.g., TCP/IP, VPN, routing).
  • Familiarity with network monitoring tools and ticket management systems (ServiceNow experience is a plus).
  • Ability to work flexible hours, including nights and weekends as needed.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a willingness to learn.
  • Excellent communication skills for effective collaboration and knowledge sharing.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experi- ence preferred.
  • CCNA or other entry-level networking certifications are a plus.
  • Experience with AVI and F5 load balancers.
  • Familiarity with Cisco and Palo Alto network devices.
  • Knowledge of Itential automation tools and Ansible.
  • Experience with network monitoring tools such as Solar Winds, Thousand Eyes, Pingdom, or Splunk.

  • Lead Generation and Prospecting: Identify and target high-potential publishers in the LATAM region through research, networking, and industry events.

  • Experience: 2+ years of B2B sales experience, preferably in ad-tech, digital advertising, or SaaS industries.

    • Proven ability to generate and close leads in a competitive market.

  • Regional Expertise: Understanding of the LATAMdigital publishing landscape, with fluency in English and preferably one additional LATAM language (Portuguese, Spanish, French).
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, or a related field (preferred but not mandatory).

Compensation Structure

  • 0–$10,000 Monthly Revenue: 10% commission.
  • $10,001–$25,000 Monthly Revenue: 12% commission.
  • $25,001–$50,000 Monthly Revenue: 15% commission.
  • $50,001+ Monthly Revenue: 18% commission.
Note: Commissions are calculated based on the revenue generated from new client acquisitions and are paid monthly.

Why Join Monetize More?

  • Innovative Environment: Work with a leading ad-tech platform that empowers publishers to succeed.
  • Uncapped Earnings: Maximize your income through a lucrative commission structure designed for high performers.
  • Career Growth: Transition to a salaried role with opportunities to advance into leadership positions.
  • Impactful Work: Help publishers in the APAC region unlock their full revenue potential with cutting-edge technology.
  • Team Culture: Join a passionate, collaborative team with a global presence and a commitment to excellence.

A Igma é uma empresa de tecnologia que cria produtos digitais críticos — sites, plataformas e apps que funcionam, crescem e deixam marca. Atuamos onde a entrega não pode falhar, com o cuidado técnico de quem já transformou grandes empresas. Unimos estratégia, engenharia e design para resolver problemas reais com consistência e impacto. Nos orgulhamos de entregar produtos tecnicamente memoráveis.

Overview

O que buscamos

Procuramos Scrum Master Pleno para facilitar e liderar a execução de sprints, focando na entrega constante de valor através de uma excelente gestão dos processos ágeis. Unimos design e tecnologia para resolver problemas complexos de empresas.

Criamos produtos digitais que revolucionam o relacionamento entre empresas e consumidores. Buscamos pessoas pró-ativas, com conhecimento e experiência em metodologias ágeis, que tenham forte capacidade de comunicação e relacionamento, que se adaptem a mudanças constantes e saibam facilitar e envolver a equipe para atingir seus objetivos.

Modelo de trabalho

  • Regime: 100% remoto
  • Modelo de contratação: PJ

Diferenciais que amamos

  • Experiência com squads multidisciplinares em ambientes de produto digital
  • Habilidade de adaptar práticas ágeis a diferentes contextos (e saber quando não seguir o manual)
  • Olhar estratégico para métricas de time (velocidade, previsibilidade, moral) e evolução contínua
  • Facilidade em navegar entre áreas técnicas e de negócio, traduzindo necessidades e prioridades
  • Interesse por produtos digitais, design centrado no usuário e cultura de entrega contínua
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas visuais e de facilitação (Excalidraw, Miro, Figjam, etc.)

Responsabilidades e premissas para a posição

Na Igma, Scrum Masters desempenham um papel fundamental na definição da estratégia dos produtos que construímos junto a nossos clientes. Como Scrum Master, você:

  • Facilitará, com o apoio dos Heads, o pilar de agilidade em uma squad, garantindo a criação de produtos valiosos com o mais alto nível de qualidade, desde a concepção até seu crescimento após ganhar o mundo
  • Será responsável por fortalecer a parceria com POs e desenvolvedores, assimilando as premissas de negócio e desdobrando a visão estratégica do produto para criar produtos digitais inspiradores, visando tanto a experiência do usuário quanto os resultados para o negócio
  • É essencial que tenha aptidão para trabalhar em equipe com profissionais de diferentes áreas, saiba se comunicar com clareza e tenha adaptabilidade para lidar com mudanças constantes

Ferramentas que utilizamos, mas não delimitam nosso trabalho

  • Azure
  • Teams
  • Workplace
  • Looker Studio
  • Slack

Premissas culturais

  • Coragem para realizar o que acredita
  • Excelência na busca constante por superação
  • Disposição genuína para se conectar com pessoas, sejam colegas, clientes ou parceiros
  • Transparência para trabalhar em um ambiente de confiança
  • Energia e intensidade para resolver problemas e entregar valor

Etapas do processo

  • Cadastro
  • Entrevista inicial
  • Entrevista Fit Cultural
  • Entrevista Técnica
  • Proposta
  • Contratação

Requisitos

  • Facilitar e moderar todas as cerimônias ágeis (daily, planning, review e retro)
  • Remover impedimentos e obstáculos que possam atrapalhar o progresso da equipe
  • Assegurar que a equipe esteja aderente aos princípios e práticas ágeis
  • Colaborar com Product Owners para gerenciar o backlog do produto e assegurar que as histórias estejam bem definidas e priorizadas
  • Facilitar a comunicação e colaboração entre os membros da equipe e PO
  • Mediar conflitos e ajudar a manter o foco da equipe no trabalho
  • Acompanhar e reportar o progresso das sprints e a saúde do time para o PO

Benefícios

  • Trabalho 100% remoto
  • Plano de Saúde individual
  • Auxílio Cuidado e Desenvolvimento
  • Incentivo à prática de esportes
  • Seguro de vida
  • Cartão multi-benefício através do Caju
  • Auxílio Remoto para investimento em equipamentos (R$2.000 anual)
  • PJ - 30 dias de férias remuneradas

title: Operation Lead (3x2 Night Shift), TOM - Transportation Operation Managment
description:
Job ID: | Amazon Servicos de Varejo do Brasil Ltda.

A ATS (Amazon Transportation Services) está procurando por pessoas motivadas para ajudar a desenvolver um processo logístico de classe mundial que entregue mercadorias no prazo e com o melhor custo. O objetivo da nossa equipe é gerenciar com excelência a execução do frete que flui através de nossas redes de transporte, focada especificamente no gerenciamento, desenvolvimento, qualidade e desempenho de transportadoras.
Esse papel exige por uma pessoa ambiciosa. Você representará uma função crítica em nossas operações de transporte mais amplas na Amazon, enquanto trabalhamos para melhorar continuamente os níveis de serviço, prezando pela segurança em nossas instalações. Isso nos ajudará a garantir que as promessas feitas aos nossos valiosos clientes sejam cumpridas sempre.
Uma pessoa especialista em operações de transporte facilita o fluxo de informações entre diferentes partes interessadas (transportadoras/hubs/armazéns) e resolve quaisquer possíveis problemas que afetem a experiência do cliente e a continuidade dos negócios. Além disso, trabalhará em operações externas com relacionamento Sort Center/Carrier, garantindo que o caminhão saia do SC para entregar os pedidos dos clientes conforme a promessa. Essa pessoa também monitora a chegada da nossa frota e aborda quaisquer possíveis problemas que ocorram durante o ciclo de vida do frete saindo do FC/SC e chegando às instalações do cliente.
Como especialista em transporte, você deve ser capaz de solucionar o problema em tempo hábil pesquisando e consultando ferramentas internas e tomando decisões em tempo real. Você deve ser capaz de entender os requisitos/ser capaz de analisar dados e observar tendências e ser capaz de impulsionar a experiência do cliente sem comprometer o tempo. Ter o conhecimento básico de Logística e deve ser capaz de se comunicar claramente na forma escrita e oral, também é necessário. A pessoa deve ser capaz de idealizar melhorias no processo e ter o zelo de levá-las à conclusão.
Nossa cultura inclusiva capacita os amazonians a oferecer os melhores resultados para nossos clientes. Não só celebramos a diversidade de nossa força de trabalho, mas também as diversas formas de trabalhar. Se você quiser solicitar uma acomodação para o processo de entrevista ou integração, informe nossa equipe e nós o conectaremos à nossa equipe de acomodação.
Essa função funcionará em turnos 3x2 das 18h às 5h
Key job responsibilities
Comunicação com clientes externos (transportadoras, fornecedores/fornecedores) e clientes internos (varejo, finanças, suporte de software, centros de atendimento, estações de entrega, centros de classificação).
Capacidade de extrair dados de vários bancos de dados (usando Excel, Access, SQL e/ou outros sistemas de gerenciamento de dados) e realizar relatórios e análises ad hoc conforme necessário é uma vantagem.
Desenvolver e/ou compreender métricas de desempenho para ajudar a impulsionar os resultados comerciais.
Deve ser capaz de entender rapidamente o impacto comercial das tendências e tomar decisões que façam sentido com base nos dados disponíveis.
Deve ser capaz de encaminhar sistematicamente problemas ou variações nas informações e dados para os proprietários e equipes relevantes e cumprir as resoluções para garantir que sejam entregues.
Trabalhe dentro de várias restrições de tempo para atender às necessidades críticas dos negócios, ao mesmo tempo em que mede e identifica as atividades realizadas.
Excelente comunicação, tanto verbal quanto escrita, para criar uma narrativa descrevendo as descobertas semanais e as variações das metas, e apresentá-las em um fórum de revisão.
Suporta o monitoramento da chegada de veículos, correta alocação de veículos no horário necessário para carregamento, nas docas corretas, respeitando todos os padrões de segurança Amazon.
Responder às atividades de agendamento de veículos.
Prioriza-define a alocação dos veículos em doca.
A day in the life
O Ops Lead é o principal ponto de contato de transportes dentro de um centro de distribuição/ sort center. Ele(a) será o guardião de segurança e qualidade em todas as movimentações de Inbound e Outbound dentro das instalações Amazon. Garantirá a execução da rotina e a exelência nos resultados das métricas. Analisará qualquer desvio, mesmo que pequeno, para evitar problemas de qualidade e segurança. Escalará pontenciais riscos de atendimento para a liderança, e garantirá o fluxo de entrada e saída de veículos sem gargalos.

Experiência em ambiente, armazenamento, logística ou fabricação voltada para o cliente
Experiência com produtos e aplicativos do Microsoft Office
Experiência com Excel

Ensino Superior Completo
Inglês no nível intermediário
Experiência com ferramentas de análise de qualidade (5 Porquês, Análise de pareto, Ishikawa, etc.)

Rio de Janeiro - Brazil

Operations & Strategy - Food Regular

About the company

If you see technology as a way to smooth your path in life, our team does too: Your Path, Our Journey.

We believe in technology that connects talented people who embrace diversity to create and share paths we don't even know about (yet!). We work to generate value not only for our users but, above all, for the communities we serve and for society as a whole, making every day better for everyone with mobility and delivery services (99) or digital payments (99Pay).

To make life easier for millions of people every day, since 2018, we have been part of DiDi DiDi Global Inc., the world’s leading mobility technology platform. We are pioneers in creating innovative solutions that start in Brazil and scale up to make a positive impact in more than 12 countries where DiDi operates. This innovation encompasses sustainability, safety, artificial intelligence, financial markets, and much more.

Whether building projects from scratch or improving our solutions, we enjoy challenges that give us butterflies, which is why we work at a fast pace with respect, collaboration, and good humor. Along this journey, we also draw strength from diverse experiences and opinions to grow together, fail quickly, learn, and adjust the course to create solutions that deliver even better results.

About the team/role

We are looking for talented professionals to join our Regional Operations team at 99Food ! This is an exciting opportunity for individuals who are highly analytical, data-driven, and eager to solve complex business challenges at the city level. If you have a start-up spirit and are always looking to create value, you would be a great fit for this team!

As part of Regional Operations , selected candidates will play a key role in driving city growth, improving marketplace performance, and shaping local strategies that connect users, restaurants, and couriers. This role requires a hands-on approach, strong problem-solving skills, and a proactive mindset to identify opportunities for growth, efficiency, and differentiation.

The ideal candidates will engage directly with restaurant partners, customers, and business development teams to understand the dynamics of each city. They will analyze local performance data, gather on-the-ground perspectives, and translate insights into actionable strategies that strengthen 99Food’s position in each market and ensure long-term sustainable growth.

In this role, you'll be...

This position will be at the core of city-level growth campaigns at 99Food . You will be responsible for managing the full campaign cycle — from identifying opportunities and improvement areas, to designing and implementing strategies that drive marketplace performance.

Your mission will be to create and execute impactful growth initiatives , ensuring that our campaigns are not only innovative but also measurable and results-oriented. This means working closely with cross-functional teams (BD, Marketing, CRM, Product, and Operations) to bring strategies to life, monitor performance, and iterate quickly to capture new opportunities.

You will also play a key role in scaling successful campaigns across cities, ensuring best practices are shared and local nuances are respected. This role demands a data-driven mindset, strategic thinking, and a strong bias for action to turn insights into concrete results that accelerate 99Food’s expansion and reinforce our presence in each market.

We're eager to be in touch because you have...

  • General Requirements
    • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Statistics, Business Administration, Economics, or related fields.
  • 2–5 years of experience in data analytics, operations, strategy, or growth-related roles.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Advanced Excel, SQL, and data analytics skills (Python/R knowledge is a plus, but not required).
  • Growth & Customer Expertise
  • Prior experience with customer-related activities (e.g., campaign management, communication strategy, customer cohort analysis, market analysis, budget management, etc.).
  • Experience with creative asset creation (CRM, ads agency, digital campaigns, etc.).
  • Stakeholder and project management experience, with exposure to Operations, Product, Sales/BD, and Marketing/CRM.
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English; Mandarin is a strong plus.

You'll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data-driven

We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win-win Collaboration

Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity

Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth

We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion

Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

Diversity & Inclusion

Diversity is not a vision of the future or something we wish to have one day, it is a non-negotiable value of who we are.

We practice inclusion, plurality, and respect. And we count on the governance of the Diversity Committee, which works together with HR, leadership and identity groups - 99Adapta, 99Afro, 99Cores, 99Mulheres, and 99Mamães. This part of our journey has been written, there remains a long road before us.

Canonical is committed to delivering the world\'s best open source platform and upholding high standards for software security across the ecosystem.   • Strong interest in software and application security
  • Experience in an agile development environment
  • Demonstrated continuous learning mindset

description:

About The Job

Did you know that Hopper technology powers some of the largest travel portals in the world? Our Hopper Technology Solutions (HTS) platform is the engine that drives travel purchases for major brands like Capital One, Commonwealth Bank of Australia, Nubank, and many more!

HTS is growing fast, and we need your help to accelerate our journey even further!

We are looking for a Frontend Engineer who can do more than just build—someone who can help architect, optimize, and scale. In this role, you won’t just develop features; you’ll help define the foundations for scalable, high-performance travel portals.

You will work on a next-generation lodging, car, and packaging platform, helping top brands drive ancillary revenue while enabling Hopper to grow exponentially. We seek an experienced React engineer passionate about building world-class user experiences and reducing long-term maintenance overhead.

Our ideal candidate is not just a strong coder but a problem-solver—someone who can balance reusable white-label solutions with tailored customizations for our partners. You’ll have a seat at the table, working closely with product, design, and engineering peers to shape the architecture that powers multiple portals at scale.

What Would Your Day-to-day Look Like

  • Work with a group of top-tier engineers in a low-process environment powered by trust and autonomy.
  • Drive decisions and consensus asynchronously with thoughtful documentation.
  • Ship fast. Learn fast. Repeat. Build new features from top to bottom…from UX to database.
  • Architect scalable front-end solutions that allow us to efficiently launch new portals.
  • Work directly with PMs and business partners to help define and refine our roadmap. Your voice matters.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with a diverse group of people, giving and receiving feedback for growth.

An Ideal Candidate Has

  • Deep expertise in React (functional components, hooks, performance optimizations, server-side rendering, hydration, and advanced state management).
  • Extensive experience with complex state management (React Context, Redux, Zustand, or similar).
  • Advanced CSS knowledge (SCSS, CSS-in-JS, Tailwind, animations, and handling browser quirks).
  • Proficiency in TypeScript, with experience developing and maintaining enterprise-scale applications.
  • Experience optimizing frontend performance (lazy loading, code-splitting, caching strategies, Lighthouse optimizations, etc.).
  • Strong understanding of frontend architecture and how to design scalable, maintainable systems.
  • Familiarity with SSR and static site generation (e.g., Next.js) for SEO-friendly experiences.
  • Experience working with backend APIs (GraphQL, REST) and handling data-fetching strategies efficiently.
  • Bonus: Familiarity with backend systems and cloud platforms (GCP, AWS, etc.) is nice to have, but not mandatory.
  • A passion for writing testable code—knowing what to test, what not to test, and what kinds of tests matter in front-end applications.

Perks And Benefits Of Working With Us

  • Well-funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary and the upsides of pre-IPO equity packages.
  • Carrot Cash travel stipend.
  • Flexdesk All Access Pass & Work-from-home stipend.
  • Entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business.
  • Open communication with management and company leadership.
  • Small, dynamic teams = massive impact.

As a Sr. Product Data Analyst, you'll be directly impacting our results through insights and reports. You'll be working close to product managers, researchers, and other business stakeholders, helping with prioritization, assessments, and business recommendations. It will be your responsibility, alongside the Analytics team, to nurture the data-driven culture within the company, making data easier to consume, be it through interactive reports, easy-to-use datasets, documentation, training.

Help Us Build the Future of Outdoor Services

At LawnStarter, we are transforming the $100B+ outdoor home services industry—making it easier for homeowners to book, manage, and enjoy services like lawn care, landscaping, and more. With $30M+ in venture funding and solid traction, we are investing in the next generation of our platform—and we are looking for a Senior Product Data Analyst to help drive it.

See what we are building!

Problems to be solved

Your primary responsibility will be to empower our organization to be more data-driven, with multiple avenues to accomplish that, such as:

  • Modeling & Analysis: A marketplace is a complex system with various moving parts and often conflicting signals. This creates opportunities to identify gaps, insights, or optimizations. The analyses and models may range from simple AB tests to multivariate models on retention or ETA. You should have advanced experience in SQL and intermediate experience in Python or R.
  • Reporting: A complex system creates many metrics to track for running the business efficiently. You will work with teams to understand their needs and help the Analytics team create and maintain a reliable, user-friendly reporting system, primarily using Tableau and Metabase.
  • Analytics Engineering: Occasionally you will work on the inner layers of our Data Warehouse to provide clean and documented datasets for reports and end users. Understanding business needs and translating them into our DW is crucial; we use DBT for data transformation, so SQL experience is a must.

Requirements

  • Experience: 4+ years in data & analytics at data-driven companies
  • Education: STEM or business background or relevant education that enables you to empower the organization to be more data-driven
  • Learning Mindset: You take pride in understanding problems deeply, asking the right questions, and approaching problems with structure and logic. You adapt to the business as needed rather than applying a fixed process blindly.
  • Team player: You collaborate effectively with others and create an environment where people are excited to work with you, with intellectual honesty and trust
  • Business focus: You understand how your analysis connects with product, customers, and financials, and can drill down metrics from top to bottom as needed
  • Bias for action: You balance careful analysis with getting things done, avoiding unnecessary perfectionism or rigid full-solution builds before validating with real use

VERY IMPORTANT REMINDER: Please upload your English resume—applications without it will not be considered.

Benefits

  • Salary range: $60-$70k USD annually
  • Work from anywhere
  • Flexible hours—complete work on your schedule

Apply now and let's grow together.

title: Staff Data Scientist / ML Engineer
description:
Overview

Welcome to TELUS Digital, where innovation meets impact. We are an award-winning digital product consultancy shaping the future of digital experiences through cutting-edge technology, agile thinking, and a people-first culture. We are the global digital section of TELUS , one of Canada’s largest telecommunications providers. Our global teams deliver transformative digital solutions and customer experiences for industry leaders in consumer electronics, finance, telecommunications, and utilities. With robust multi-shore delivery capabilities, multi-language programs, and secure infrastructure, we ensure exceptional service backed by our multi-billion-dollar parent company.

Location and Flexibility

This role can be fully remote for candidates based in Brazil, due to team distribution and occasional in-person opportunities. If you are based in São Paulo or Porto Alegre, you are welcome to work from one of our offices on a flexible schedule.

The Opportunity

As a Data Scientist / Machine Learning Engineer on our team, you'll design, develop, and deliver machine learning solutions, decipher loosely defined problems using complex datasets, and determine appropriate analytical and modeling techniques. You'll analyze structured and unstructured data, establish automated processes for large-scale modeling, perform exploratory analysis, and collaborate with peers on data acquisition and exploration, demonstrating a strong sense of ownership and urgency.

Responsibilities

  • Work on all aspects of the design, development and delivery of machine learning enabled solutions for our clients;
  • Come up with solutions to loosely defined business problems by leveraging pattern detection over complex datasets across multiple platforms;
  • Establish efficient, automated processes for large-scale modeling;
  • Become part of a highly skilled and geographically distributed team;
  • Collaborate with peers on problem definitions, data acquisition, data exploration, visualization as well as building the tools that support this process;
  • Strong sense of ownership, urgency and drive.

Qualifications

  • Relevant experience in data science/ machine learning development.
  • Bachelor and/or Master degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science or other related subject.
  • Proficiency in Python.
  • Experience with machine learning frameworks (like Keras, TensorFlow, or PyTorch) and libraries (like scikit-learn).
  • Strong understanding of machine learning algorithms, processes, tools and platforms.
  • Ability to work on distributed cloud platforms

Bonus Points

  • Experience with container management and machine learning deployment frameworks, such as Kubernetes, Kubeflow and MLFlow.
  • Software development experience from scoping, requirements design, development, integration, testing, go live to PROD (vs internal research work)

Why TELUS Digital?

At TELUS Digital, you'll work with world-class brands like FOX, HBO, PepsiCo, and Domino's, building transformative digital products that impact millions. Our global reach allows you to collaborate with diverse, international teams, solving complex problems and delivering tech-driven solutions that matter. We thrive on engineering excellence, using the latest technologies in cloud computing, AI, machine learning, DevOps, microservices architecture, and data engineering. Our teams embrace Agile methodologies, CI/CD pipelines, and a DevOps-first mindset to deliver solutions at scale.

In addition to being part of an international and innovative consultancy company, you will have:

  • A Global Innovation Hub: Be part of an international consultancy at the forefront of technology
  • Work-Life Harmony: Enjoy flexible hours and autonomy to balance your professional and personal life
  • Cutting-Edge Tech Playground: Dive into the latest technologies and shape the future of digital solutions
  • Prestigious Partnerships: Collaborate with world-renowned brands, making a real impact in the market
  • Growth-Centric Environment: Thrive in our collaborative ecosystem with a clear career development path
  • Global Exposure: Embrace optional international travel opportunities to broaden your horizons

Some of our benefits:

  • Health and dental plan
  • Life insurance
  • Monthly voucher for meals, culture, education, health and mobility
  • Child care assistance and more!

At TELUS Digital, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. We are committed to building an inclusive team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, beliefs, and experiences. Therefore we provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants regardless of race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, or disability.

We will only use the information you provide to process your application and to produce tracking statistics. Since we do not request personal data deemed sensitive, we ask you to abstain from sharing that Information with us. For more information on how we use your information, see our Privacy Policy.

description:
The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 30 million people use Speechify’s text-to-speech products to turn whatever they’re reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify’s text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its App of the Day.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

With the growth of our Android app, being the most used text-to-speech app in the Play Store, we find the need for a Senior Android Engineer to help us support the new user base as well as work on new and exciting projects to push us forward.

This is a key role and ideal for someone who thinks strategically, enjoys fast-paced environments, passionate about making product decisions, and has experience building great user experiences that delight users.

We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.

Our interview process involves several technical interviews and we aim to complete them within 1 week.

What You’ll Do

  • Owning major features and working closely with our design team - take ownership of features inside the app and become responsible of delivering high quality features
  • Shape the future of our Android team
  • Own, maintain and improve reliability metrics for key features
  • Participate in discussions across different teams - Product, Design, Engineering
  • Review pull requests, and support other teammates
  • Handle critical issues or cope with unexpected challenges
  • Take ownership of feature releases and provide nightly builds for the QA team

An Ideal Candidate Should Have

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience
  • Familiarity with Android components
  • Experience building or contributing to at least one Android app
  • Product design intuition and user empathy
  • Drive to push the boundaries of Android UI/UX
  • Understanding of the importance of tests and how to approach writing tests
  • Self-drive to improve the app and codebase above and beyond what's outlined in the spec
  • Rock solid experience with Kotlin, Kotlin Coroutines, Kotlin Flow, Dagger 2, MVVM, Clean Architecture, Background Services, Music Player Service, Android Animations, Jetpack Navigation, JUnit tests
  • Excellent communication skills
  • User oriented problem solving approach
  • Driven with continuous feedback from leaders

Bonus:

  • Experience building, maintaining, or otherwise contributing to open source projects in Android
  • Experience with iOS, Web or NodeJS

Technologies we use:

  • Kotlin
  • Kotlin Coroutines
  • Kotlin Flow
  • Jetpack Navigation
  • Dagger 2
  • Room
  • Custom Views, Canvas & Paint
  • Jetpack Compose
  • JUnit

What We offer

  • A fast-growing environment where you can help shape the company and product.
  • An entrepreneurial-minded team that supports risk, intuition, and hustle.
  • A hands-off management approach so you can focus and do your best work.
  • An opportunity to make a big impact in a transformative industry.

When you think of InComm Payments, think of Innovative Payments Technology. We were founded over 30 years ago and continue to be a pioneer in the payment (FinTech) industry. Since our inception, we have grown to be a team of over 3,000 employees in 35 countries around the world. We own over 400 global technical patents and a network that includes over 525,000 points of retail distribution that points to our industry expertise.

We are significantly growing our Engineering and IT teams in Brazil and are focused on finding talent for various financial technology (Fintech) engineering, database, development, and testing teams.

InComm Payments is highly focused on our people and their growth, and we work hard to make a career at InComm Payments meaningful and rewarding. We value innovation, quality, passion, integrity and responsibility in all that we do, and we are looking for great people to join our team as we move forward towards a very bright future. We anticipate developing future leaders for our teams in Brazil!

Benefits include health and dental insurance, meal and restaurant vouchers, fixed monthly stipend for internet and mobile expenses, InComm hardware/software, and annual bonuses! All positions are CLT.

You can learn more about InComm Payments by visiting our Website or connecting with us on LinkedIn, YouTube, Twitter, Facebook, or Instagram.

About This Opportunity

As a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET), you’ll support teams across both Waterfall and Agile teams by delivering robust automated testing solutions. You’ll help define and maintain quality strategies, validation methods, and best practices across development, testing, UAT, and production environments to ensure consistent and reliable software delivery.

CLT and fully remote position. Must reside in Brazil. Benefits include:

  • Health and dental insurance
  • Meal and restaurant vouchers
  • Fixed monthly stipend for internet and mobile expenses
  • Company-issued device (hardware and software)
  • Annual bonuses

Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain automated test scripts using Java, Python, or tool-specific languages
  • Automate regression, integration, and functional test cases following best practices
  • Balance manual vs. automated testing efforts to optimize coverage
  • Participate in code reviews and design discussions to improve product quality
  • Collaborate across Dev, QA, and product teams in a multi-tiered environment
  • Estimate testing efforts and timelines for sprint and project deliverables
  • Coordinate with third-party teams to ensure quality and timely delivery
  • Write and maintain QA documentation and standards
  • Optimize SQL queries and analyze automation script issues
  • Report defects with clear documentation and track quality risks
  • Support production implementations during off-hours maintenance windows
  • Monitor results against technical specs and distribute findings to stakeholders

Qualifications

  • Associate Degree, or, Technologo (Technologist) Degree, or higher is required.
  • 3+ years of experience in test automation using Python and Java
  • Hands-on with automation testing tools: Postman, Robot, SoapUI, RestAssured, Playwright, DevTest (LISA), Locust
  • Strong background in white-box and black-box testing in multi-tiered environments
  • Experience with test frameworks like JUnit
  • Familiarity with CI/CD tools: GitHub, Jenkins, ArgoCD
  • Basic understanding of Kubernetes and containerized apps (preferred)
  • Proven ability to define and maintain QA strategies, policies, and documentation
  • Proficient in IDEs like Eclipse and IntelliJ

O Promotor de Merchandising é na linha de frente com os nossos clientes representando a Coty e fazendo com que os nossos produtos estejam sempre disponíveis para os nossos consumidores.

Sobre a Coty

Fundada em Paris em 1904, a Coty é uma das maiores empresas de beleza do mundo. Com portfólio de marcas consagradas em fragrâncias, maquiagens e esmaltes, cuidados com pele e corpo, a empresa atende clientes em todo o mundo e está presente em cerca de 130 países. A Coty e as suas marcas estimulam o empoderamento das pessoas para que se expressem livresmente, criando suas próprias visões de beleza; além de serem comprometidas em fomentar positivo impacto no planeta.

No Brasil, o Grupo Coty conta com aproximadamente 2,4 mil funcionários alocados em suas empresas, localizadas no Estado de São Paulo (área de Pesquisa e Desenvolvimento e sede administrativa); no Estado de Goiás (fábrica Savoy e o principal centro de distribuição); e no Estado do Rio de Janeiro (centro de distribuição).

Localmente, fabricamos e comercializamos milhões de produtos todos os anos, de nossas tradicionais marcas brasileiras - como Risqué, Monange, Bozzano, Paixão, Cenoura & Bronze e outras muito conhecidas pelos brasileiros. Além disso, também comercializamos nossas fragrâncias internacionais, licenciadas de famosas marcas (Calvin Klein, Lacoste, Hugo Boss, Chloé, Burberry, Gucci, Tiffany, entre outras); e produtos de maquiagem e skincare, com Kylie Cosmetics e Kylie Skin.

Na Coty, acreditamos que hoje ninguém pode controlar ou deve ditar o que é ou não bonito. Estamos em busca de uma nova era de beleza - uma em que, juntos, a cocriamos de maneira que você possa se expressar da forma que desejar. Como companhia dessa indústria, nosso propósito é viabilizar, conjuntamente, todas as visões de beleza.

O conceito de beleza não é fixo; é algo fluido, como a água – em constante evolução e adaptação. Não é singular, e sim plural. É hora de desconstruir todos os conceitos de beleza.

Tornamos ‘fearless kindness’ ( sem medo de ser gentil, gentileza destemida ) a base dos nossos valores, porque sabemos que agora, mais do que nunca, o mundo precisa de gentileza. É um atributo e uma ação que tem um efeito de ondulação que irradia muito - gentileza para consigo mesmo, gentileza para com os outros e gentileza para com o planeta.

Portanto, hoje e todos os dias, junte-se a nós para fazer da ‘fearless kindness’ a base para suas decisões e ações; juntos, vamos causar impacto positivo no nosso próprio bem-estar mental e daqueles que nos rodeiam.

Queremos PROFISSIONAIS DIVERSOS no nosso time!

Acreditamos que vivências diferentes tornam o time vencedor. Por isso, nossas oportunidades são para todos, independentemente de raça, religião, cor, nacionalidade, idade, gênero, deficiência, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, expressão de gênero, estado civil ou qualquer outra característica. Ou seja, valorizamos exatamente quem VOCÊ é!

title: Diretor De Operações
description:
A Brunel está em busca de um Diretor de Operações (Perfuração) para integrar o time de um de seus maiores clientes no setor de Petróleo e Gás no Rio de Janeiro, RJ.

Como Diretor de Operações de Perfuração, você será responsável por supervisionar todo o planejamento e a execução de campanhas de perfuração, garantindo segurança, conformidade regulatória, eficiência operacional e alinhamento com as expectativas da empresa e clientes.

Responsabilidades

  • Liderar todo o ciclo das operações de perfuração, desde o planejamento do poço e mobilização da sonda até a execução e análise pós-operação.
  • Gerenciar contratados de perfuração e prestadores de serviço, assegurando o cumprimento dos padrões técnicos e de segurança.
  • Desenvolver e implementar estratégias de controle de custos para otimizar os orçamentos de perfuração (CAPEX/OPEX).
  • Supervisionar a seleção de sondas e garantir conformidade com as regras de aceitação de sondas da Petrobras e os requisitos do RASMA.
  • Manter rigorosa conformidade com as normas da ANP e as NRs (Normas Regulamentadoras) brasileiras relacionadas à segurança, meio ambiente e saúde ocupacional.
  • Coordenar a preparação técnica e a documentação para auditorias e inspeções da Petrobras.
  • Identificar, documentar e liderar o encerramento de itens de não conformidade (Categorias A, B e C), conforme a classificação da Petrobras.
  • Atuar como elo principal entre as partes interessadas internas e órgãos reguladores (ANP, Petrobras, IBAMA, etc.).
  • Monitorar e reportar indicadores-chave de desempenho (KPIs), incluindo ROP, NPT e prazos de entrega de poços.
  • Promover uma cultura orientada para a segurança por meio de programas proativos de SMS, investigações de incidentes e gestão de riscos.

Conformidade e Regulação

  • Familiaridade com as regras da Petrobras para aceitação de sondas de perfuração, incluindo especificações de equipamentos, protocolos de inspeção e requisitos de documentação.
  • Capacidade de comunicar e resolver não conformidades classificadas como Categoria A, B e C pela Petrobras, atuando diretamente com equipes de inspeção e auditoria.
  • Conhecimento aprofundado das regulamentações da ANP que afetam operações de perfuração, relatórios, conteúdo local e licenciamento operacional.
  • Compreensão dos protocolos RASMA (Rig Acceptance Safety and Maintenance Assessment) da Petrobras, incluindo revisão periódica e mitigação de riscos.
  • Conhecimento abrangente das NRs relacionadas ao setor de óleo e gás, incluindo NR-10 (Segurança em Eletricidade), NR-12 (Máquinas), NR-13 (Vasos de Pressão), NR-20 (Inflamáveis) e NR-37 (Operações Offshore).

Requisitos

  • Graduação em Engenharia de Petróleo, Engenharia Mecânica ou áreas correlatas.
  • Mínimo de 10 a 15 anos de experiência em operações de perfuração, incluindo funções de liderança.
  • Experiência comprovada em projetos e auditorias operados pela Petrobras.
  • Certificações em controle de poços (IWCF/IADC), HSE e conformidade regulatória.
  • Fortes habilidades interpessoais e de resolução de problemas, com capacidade de engajar partes interessadas técnicas e não técnicas.
  • Inglês Fluente
