title: Página da Vaga | Executivo(a) de Pré-Vendas (SDR)
description:
Job description

Aqui na Korp, nossa cultura é movida por uma palavra: pessoas. Acreditamos que profissionais bem capacitados são pilares fundamentais da nossa empresa, por isso buscamos novos talentos para compor o time.

Para a vaga de Executivo de Pré-Vendas (SDR) , buscamos um profissional responsável por fazer a prospecção e um primeiro diagnóstico dos Leads para entender se ele é ou não é um cliente em potencial. O objetivo é gerar listas de oportunidades com PIC (sigla de Perfil Ideal de Cliente), mapeando a persona e criando o interesse nas soluções VIASOFT KORP, sabendo o que falar no momento certo para que o lead aceite avançar para uma reunião com executivos de negócios. Trata-se de um trabalho muito importante dentro da engenharia de vendas, pois dá celeridade nas vendas, já que o executivo hunter encaminha negociações com um excelente perfil de compra das soluções e abertura para conversa com as pessoas certas.

Essa oportunidade de carreira só faz sentido para quem:

Acredita no potencial que a tecnologia tem de dinamizar negócios, potencializar iniciativas empresariais e levar às melhores práticas de gestão;

Tem propósitos firmes de desenvolver carreira na área de vendas e enxerga nesta vaga a oportunidade e o meio para conquistar seus objetivos profissionais;

Tem vocação para identificar empresas com potencial para realizar ainda mais através do uso das nossas soluções;

Compreende que vender, acima de tudo, é ajudar o cliente a comprar;

Coloca o sucesso do cliente acima de qualquer interesse individual e jamais promete algo para fechar um negócio sem a certeza de que será capaz de atender;

Gosta de trabalhar com metas audaciosas.

Se identificou? então se inscreva na vaga!

Main responsibilities

  • Realizar diariamente ligações telefônicas de prospecção para conversar com os responsáveis nas indústrias com PIC (perfil ideal de cliente) para soluções Korp;
  • Gerar novas oportunidades de negócio para a VIASOFT KORP, pesquisando e encontrando empresas com PIC;
  • Identificar quem são as pessoas mais indicadas dentro da empresa potencial cliente a falar sobre soluções em software de gestão;
  • Extrair informações necessárias do lead para validar se as atividades econômicas da empresa e suas necessidades tem fit com o que a VIASOFT KORP oferece como soluções;
  • A partir da identificação que o lead possui um fit com as soluções VIASOFT KORP, tem a missão criar interesse nas soluções VIASOFT KORP e de “vender” a próxima etapa do processo de vendas: uma reunião com o executivo de negócios closer;
  • Manter atualizadas na plataforma de CRM todas as informações dos leads e as interações realizadas ao longo da prospecção;
  • Marcar reuniões na agenda dos executivos de negócios closer, para que possam dar continuidade nas negociações com leads qualificados;
  • Promover o “passe de bastão” ao executivo de negócios closer, deixando claro ao lead que estará direcionando as tratativas a outro profissional, mas que não é um abandono por parte do executivo hunter;
  • Acompanhar os indicadores de desempenho: número de novas prospecções (leads novos contatados), taxa de conversão de leads com PIC em OPORTUNIDADE e OPORTUNIDADES transferidos;
  • Auxiliar na meta de número de OPORTUNIDADES qualificados.

Requirements and skills

  • Experiência com prospecção ativa voltado para a venda de ERP;
  • Habilidades excepcionais de comunicação oral e escrita;
  • Não só conhecer, mas também acreditar nas soluções que está vendendo;
  • Criatividade para contornar objeções;
  • Personalidade altamente motivada, persuasiva e orientada para o sucesso;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe de forma colaborativa;
  • Fortes habilidades de gerenciamento de tempo;
  • Ter no mínimo 6 meses de experiência atuando com SDR;
  • Será um diferencial ter experiência com vendas de softwares, plataformas e aplicativos;
  • Habilidades de solução de vendas consultivas, incluindo a capacidade de articular uma declaração de valor de retorno sobre o investimento clara e concisa.

Additional information

Para participar do processo seletivo, você precisa concluir o preenchimento do teste de conhecimentos técnicos da vaga, por isso deixe para preencher sua inscrição quando você tiver tempo hábil para concluir totalmente o teste técnico. Seu prazo de conclusão é de 24 horas e se não concluir neste período terá sua inscrição revogada.

Plano de saúde;

Totalpass;

Auxílio Home Office.

title: Database administrator sql server remote
description:
Descrição do cargo

Administrador(a) de Banco de Dados Sênior (DBA), com especialidade em SQL Server, responsável por gerenciar e manter o sistema de banco de dados SQL Server, assegurando a integridade dos dados, performance e segurança. Lidera iniciativas complexas, orienta DBAs mais juniores e atua como referência técnica.

Responsabilidades

  • Instalar, configurar e manter instâncias e bancos de dados SQL Server (versões 2012 a 2022).
  • Desenvolver, implementar e gerenciar estratégias de Backup e Recovery (Full, Differential, Transaction log, Point-in-time recovery).
  • Implementar, gerenciar e solucionar problemas em soluções de Alta Disponibilidade (HA) & Disaster Recovery (DR), como Always On Availability Groups e Replicação Transacional.
  • Gerenciar a segurança do banco de dados, incluindo usuários, roles, permissões, e implementar recursos como Transparent Data Encryption (TDE), Data Masking e Row-Level Security.
  • Configurar e gerenciar a Auditoria do SQL Server para fins de segurança e conformidade (LGPD, GDPR/HIPAA).
  • Realizar tuning e otimização de performance de queries complexas, analisando planos de execução, utilizando Query Store e definindo estratégias de indexação.
  • Gerenciar e manter índices (Clustered, Non-Clustered, Columnstore) e estatísticas.
  • Utilizar ferramentas de diagnóstico como SQL Profiler, Extended Events e DMVs para identificar e solucionar gargalos de performance.
  • Realizar tuning de I/O, CPU e Memória para otimizar a performance do SQL Server.
  • Otimizar a configuração e uso do TempDB.
  • Analisar e resolver problemas de concorrência, como Locking, Blocking e Deadlocks.
  • Desenvolver T-SQL complexo, incluindo stored procedures, functions, triggers, views, CTEs, Dynamic SQL e manipulação de XML/JSON.
  • Desenvolver scripts em PowerShell para automação de tarefas administrativas e de manutenção.
  • Criar, gerenciar e otimizar Jobs complexos no SQL Server Agent.
  • Administrar ambientes de banco de dados na nuvem (Azure SQL Database, SQL Server em VMs - IaaS, Managed Instances - PaaS) e híbridos.
  • Implementar e gerenciar estratégias de Backup e Disaster Recovery na nuvem.
  • Utilizar Azure Data Factory para fluxos de integração de dados.
  • Desenvolver, implantar e manter pacotes SSIS para migração e transformação de dados (ETL).
  • Implementar e gerenciar Change Data Capture (CDC) e Change Tracking.
  • Implementar monitoramento proativo da saúde dos bancos de dados e health checks.
  • Utilizar e gerenciar ferramentas de monitoramento de terceiros (ex: Redgate, DataDog SentryOne, SQL Monitor).
  • Desenvolver scripts para automação de tarefas de manutenção e criação de alertas.
  • Configurar, gerenciar e analisar logs de auditoria e monitoramento de atividades no SQL Server.
  • Implementar e gerenciar a automação de deployments de banco de dados (ex: Flyway, Liquibase, Redgate).
  • Integrar o gerenciamento de código de banco de dados com sistemas de controle de versão (Git, Azure DevOps, SVN).
  • Integrar e manter deployments de banco de dados em pipelines de CI/CD (Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions).
  • Liderar tecnicamente iniciativas e projetos de banco de dados.
  • Orientar DBAs de níveis júnior e pleno.
  • Criar e manter documentação técnica detalhada sobre o ambiente de banco de dados.

Requisitos

  • Inglês fluente
  • Experiência consolidada (8+ anos) em administração de banco de dados, com especialidade em SQL Server.
  • Profundo conhecimento em instalação, configuração e manutenção do SQL Server (versões 2012, 2014, 2016, 2019, 2022).
  • Experiência prática com estratégias de Backup e Recovery
  • Conhecimento avançado em segurança SQL Server
  • Experiência com requisitos de conformidade (LGPD, GDPR/HIPAA).
  • Domínio de Performance Tuning
  • Experiência com ferramentas de diagnóstico de performance: SQL Profiler, Extended Events, DMVs.
  • Conhecimento em tuning de I/O, CPU, Memória e otimização de TempDB.
  • Experiência em troubleshooting de Locking, Blocking e Deadlocks.
  • Proficiência em desenvolvimento T-SQL complexo
  • Experiência com ambientes de banco de dados em nuvem
  • Conhecimento em Data Warehousing e integração com ferramentas de BI
  • Experiência com sistemas de controle de versão e pipelines de CI/CD (Git, Azure DevOps, SVN).

Benefícios e Desenvolvimento

  • Benefícios alinhados à cultura da empresa, com foco em desenvolvimento profissional, programas de certificação e oportunidades de crescimento.

Our Vision

We aim to be the ultimate all-in-one platform for small business growth, allowing owners to manage every part of their business efficiently and effortlessly.

Our journey began as an agency, and we’ve already helped thousands of clients succeed. Now, we’re embracing an exciting new chapter: becoming a SaaS-first company. As a UX/UI Product Designer , you’ll work closely with the product, engineering, and design teams to shape a tool that genuinely works for our small business clients. You’ll focus on refining the user experience across key areas of our platform like client social media accounts, online business listings, scheduling, invoicing, and client communications by designing clean, accessible, and intuitive interfaces that reflect how our customers actually work.

This role is ideal for a detail-oriented designer who understands real user needs and translates them into clear, intuitive flows and interfaces that deliver immediate value and keep users coming back.

  • Translate product requirements into wireframes, flows, and prototypes that are simple, usable, and scalable

What We Really Need From You

  • Intermediate English proficiency, both written and verbal required
  • Familiarity with B2B or SaaS platforms, ideally tools built for small business users
  • Comfort collaborating with product managers, engineers, and fellow designers throughout the lifecycle of a feature

What Would Be Big Pluses

  • Experience with user testing or conducting lightweight research
  • A solid eye for visual detail and a desire to make things feel clean, clear, and consistent
  • Excitement about working in a fast-moving environment where we’re building toward a bigger vision

What You’ll Love About Working at Olly Olly

  • Competitive pay based on your experience.
  • Flexible work: 100% remote; Monday-Friday, 8:00 am - 5:00 pm CST
  • Work-life balance: Generous PTO, including 15 vacation days and U.S. holidays.
  • Growth-oriented culture: Join an inclusive, international, and innovative team where your contributions make a tangible difference.

Why Choose Us?

Join us during this pivotal transition as we transform from an agency to a human-centric SaaS provider. Your ideas, strategies, and solutions will directly impact the success of small businesses. And our own growth!

Let’s shape the future of small business growth together! Apply now to join a team that’s as committed as they are supportive of each other.

Diversity and Inclusion at Olly Olly

At Olly Olly, we celebrate differences in background, culture, abilities, and perspectives because diversity drives innovation and creativity. Your voice matters here; it really does! And your unique perspective will help us shape the future of small business growth.

We are seeking highly qualified professionals with (Master's or PhD) in Medical Microbiology to support the development of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs).

title: Sr. Data Science Analyst
description:
Overview

Come Make an Impact on Millions of Brazilians! At RecargaPay, we’re on a mission to deliver the best payment experience for Brazilian consumers and small businesses — by building a powerful digital ecosystem where the banked and unbanked connect, and where consumers and merchants have a one-stop shop for all their financial needs.

We serve over 10 million users and process more than USD 4 billion annually. We’ve been profitable since 2022 and operate our own credit business. We are an AI-first, 100% remote team, scaling in the rapidly changing Brazilian financial market. Our goal? Deliver the best payment experience in Brazil for people and small businesses alike. We value autonomy, ownership, and a bias for action. We’re looking for people who are curious, hands-on, and driven by impact — who want to solve real problems, work with strong teams, and rethink what’s possible. If you’re ready to do your best work, at scale, with purpose — this is your place.

Responsibilities

As a Senior Data Scientist on the Product team, you will be responsible for:

  • Develop and implement advanced machine learning models to quantify the risk level of transactions and credit operations, and optimize user onboarding and reduce losses.
  • Design and conduct complex data analyses on large volumes of transactional, user behavior, and demographic data to identify patterns, trends, and opportunities for model enhancement.
  • Optimize and maintain existing credit models, ensuring their stability, accuracy, and business impact through continuous monitoring and refinement.
  • Lead the design and execution of A/B tests and other experiments related to credit decision strategies, translating results into actionable business recommendations.
  • Build and optimize robust and scalable data pipelines for model training, inference, and performance monitoring.
  • Contribute to the adoption of best practices in data science, including model documentation, version control (Git), and code quality.

Requirements

  • Experience in data science, with a proven track record of independently developing and deploying machine learning models in a production environment.
  • Programming and Tools: Proficiency in Python, SQL, and Spark. Experience with libraries such as Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, and Scikit-learn. Familiarity with platforms like Databricks, AWS, and Azure. Experience with Git for version control and collaboration.
  • Analytical Modeling & Machine Learning: Strong experience in building and implementing machine learning models. Solid knowledge of classification, regression, and clustering algorithms, as well as feature engineering and model selection techniques. Experience with model explanation techniques.
  • Data Analysis: Ability to handle large datasets and write efficient, optimized SQL queries. Strong experience with exploratory data analysis and evaluating model features.
  • Statistical Knowledge: Strong understanding of A/B testing and statistics, including experimental design and statistical significance. Proficient knowledge of predictive modeling metrics like AUC, KS, precision, and recall.
  • Other Skills: Knowledge of data modeling principles and experience building robust and scalable data models. An analytical mindset with a strong focus on problem-solving. Strong mathematical skills with the ability to optimize complex problems.
  • Innovative Thinking: Applying theoretical knowledge of statistics, economics, and behavioral finance to optimize proposed solutions.
  • Communication: Ability to translate complex technical findings into actionable business insights and communicate them clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Collaboration: Willingness to work in a collaborative and dynamic environment, actively contributing to team knowledge sharing.

Bonus Points

  • Proficiency with PySpark for distributed data processing in large-scale environments.
  • Experience with MLOps and deploying machine learning models into production.
  • Familiarity with model monitoring in production environments.
  • Exposure to Open Finance, credit bureau data, or behavioral features.
  • Previous experience in fintechs or financial services companies.

Benefits

  • Competitive and market-aligned salary.
  • Remote work — wherever you are, you’re part of the team!
  • Home office allowance through a monthly deposit in the RecargaPay app.
  • Health and dental plans with no co-pay.
  • Life insurance.
  • Flexible meal allowance (via Flash).
  • TotalPass membership to take care of your health.
  • Spanish or Portuguese classes.

Diversity & Inclusion

At RecargaPay, you’ll have the freedom to be who you are because we believe that diverse perspectives and experiences make us more creative and stronger. Here, everyone is welcome to express themselves authentically. We value the richness of each journey and the multiple ways of seeing the world, without distinctions of gender, race, sexual orientation, age, religion, or any other characteristic that makes us unique.

About the use of your Data

By sharing your resume with us, you authorize the use of your data for analysis during the selection process and possibly for other opportunities within the RecargaPay group. You can request the update or deletion of your information at any time, in accordance with LGPD (General Data Protection Law).

Job Title: Generative AI Associate Analyst (LLM Training – Medical Domain)

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Flexible Contract Role (Part-time, up to 25 hours weekly)

About The Role

We are seeking highly qualified professionals with (Master\'s or PhD) in Medical Microbiology to support the development of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs). As a Rater / AI Trainer, you will play a critical role in shaping how AI understands and communicates complex biomedical knowledge, with a specific focus on microbiological sciences.

This role involves evaluating AI-generated responses for scientific accuracy, contextual integrity, and clinical relevance within the field of medical microbiology. Your feedback and annotations will inform the improvement of AI systems used in healthcare education, diagnostics support, public health communication, and biomedical research.

Key Responsibilities

  • Critically assess AI-generated responses in topics including microbial taxonomy, infectious disease mechanisms, host–pathogen interactions, diagnostic microbiology, antimicrobial resistance, and laboratory methodologies.
  • Apply structured annotation to texts, including labeling for scientific correctness, terminology accuracy, logical structure, and clinical relevance.
  • Categorize model outputs using domain-specific taxonomies (e.g., pathogen type, disease process, diagnostic method).
  • Create real-world clinical or laboratory scenarios with researchers to design and test prompts to assess the model\'s reasoning and adaptability to professional contexts (e.g., interpreting culture reports, recommending diagnostic tests, understanding resistance profiles).

Required Qualifications

  • Master\'s or PhD in Medical Microbiology, Immunology, or a closely related biomedical discipline.
  • Demonstrated expertise in core areas such as microbial pathogenesis, clinical diagnostics, virology, bacteriology, parasitology, and immunology.
  • Familiarity with laboratory procedures, microbiological instrumentation, and interpretation of diagnostic test results (e.g., blood cultures, PCR, AST).
  • Excellent written communication skills and fluency in English.
  • As part of the project, you are required to complete the English language assessment. The assessment is mandatory & non-billable.

About the Role

As a Software Engineer at BWZ you are responsible for the whole development process, starting with discovery, planning and development, and ending with testing and deployment. You will work in an environment that offers freedom with responsibility and encourages simplicity with risk taking.

You will be working in BWZ's Tech Team, heavily involved in the development of our back-end systems and integrations (using Node.js, Python, AWS, etc.), and participating in the development and architecture of our multi-site Web Platform (built in WordPress) and our Ad Tech Platform (built in Ruby on Rails), among other systems and products.

You can work remotely or in a flexible regime if you are in Curitiba, Brazil. Please note that our teams work in the PST time zone, and your hours should be at least partially compatible with it.

What You’ll Be Doing

Reporting to the Technology Director, you will work with the BWZ Labs Team and closely with the Web Platform. You will develop internal systems used by dozens of employees, as well as customer-facing systems used by thousands of clients.

You don’t have to know all the answers, because you will have time to research and learn new technologies and solutions. You will be encouraged to make suggestions and implementations that fit our product needs to better perform and scale.

  • You are a software engineer with meaningful experience building web applications
  • You are good at curating your own priorities
  • You are curious about how things are done and how they work
  • You are good at communicating your deliveries and demands with pairs and stakeholders
  • You don’t like repetitive tasks, so you automate everything you can
  • You like to test new things, and you don’t mind if it doesn't work and move on

How Your Success Will Be Measured

  • We don’t like to measure effort; we focus on effectiveness
  • You will be accountable for your results, not the hours you worked
  • You will be part of a team; collaboration is a key factor

Your Skillset Includes

  • Curiosity to understand how things work
  • An openness to learning new technology
  • Great time-management and prioritization skills
  • Openness to learn and use new programming languages
  • You are comfortable reading/writing documentation for others
  • Good communication in English

Required Experience for this Position

  • Meaningful experience building and maintaining web applications with modern frameworks (e.g., SolidJS, React, Next.js, or similar)
  • Proven track record of full-stack development, covering frontend, backend, and deployment
  • Strong experience with CMS platforms, particularly WordPress (custom themes, plugins, REST API, headless setups)
  • Solid understanding of JavaScript/TypeScript and structuring large-scale applications
  • Experience with backend development in Node.js, PHP, or similar languages

Nice to Haves for this Position

  • Experience developing and consuming APIs, including GraphQL
  • Comfort with writing automated tests (unit, integration, and end-to-end) and implementing CI/CD pipelines
  • Exposure to SEO best practices and accessibility standards for modern web platforms

About Us

Black and White Zebra is a rapidly growing, independent media tech company headquartered in Vancouver, B.C. Canada. Since 2012, our portfolio of influential digital publications has been helping millions of people succeed at work.

Our brands cover project management, product management, people management, customer experience, quality assurance and others, with the goal of connecting people with the knowledge, skills and tools they need to succeed professionally.

We started in 2011 as The Digital Project Manager blog, founded by our CEO Ben Aston. Since then, we’ve grown into an international team of 70+ creators, strategists, and innovators with a portfolio of more than 14 online publications. We value an impact-driven environment that combines startup agility with agency creativity and a global footprint.

We have ranked #30 in The Globe and Mail’s Fastest Growing Company list and received a CMI award for Best Digital Publication for The Digital Project Manager. We are listed among Canada’s Top Small & Medium Employers and Best Employers in BC.

Our mission is to create a playbook for the future of work and empower communities to contribute to it. Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.

The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Nos motivamos a enxergar o impacto do nosso trabalho na vida do cliente, é vendo que melhoramos a vida dele que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.

Como é ser uma pessoa Sênior Data Scientist:

Apoiar decisões estratégicas de negócio através de experimentos com rigor estatístico , tanto no online quanto no offline (agentes comerciais, polos, canais).

  • Definir e executar A/B tests, multivariados e quasi-experimentos;
  • Criar metodologias robustas para experimentos offline (polos comerciais);
  • Desenvolver frameworks para simulação e análise de poder estatístico;
  • Trabalhar em parceria com PMs e engenheiros na evolução da plataforma de experimentação;
  • Garantir comunicação clara dos resultados para stakeholders executivos.

O que esperamos de você:

  • Forte background em estatística e design de experimentos (DOE, causal inference);
  • Experiência prática com A/B testing e experimentos em larga escala;
  • Fluência em Python ou R para análise estatística;
  • Vivência em ferramentas de experimentação (Amplitude, Growthbook, VWO);
  • Capacidade de traduzir resultados técnicos em impacto de negócio;

O que aumenta suas chances:

  • Experiência em experimentação offline;
  • Experiência em modelos quasi-experimentais (dif-in-dif, propensity score matching).

Plano de Saúde e Odontológico

Hospital Digital, da Vitta: contamos com uma equipe médica multidisciplinar, terapeutas e um time de saúde disponível 24 horas por dia 7 dias por semana de forma rápida e prática

Horário flexível

description:
Senior Software Engineer, Fund Operations

The Company You’ll Join

Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world-class software, purpose-built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Trusted by 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries, Carta’s platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence.

Carta’s Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end-to-end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital.

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow. As a Senior Software Engineer I or Senior Software Engineer II , you’ll work to solve problems like:

  • How can we leverage the power of AI to create exceptional, seamless experiences for our customers?
  • How can we design reliable systems for tracking capital movement across a fund’s lifecycle, from initial call to final distribution?
  • How do we build flexible reporting pipelines that adapt to evolving fund structures and support compliance with financial regulations?
  • How can we apply machine learning to automate workflows traditionally powered by spreadsheets and manual reviews?

The Team You’ll Work With

Carta’s Fund Operations Engineering Organization is designing the infrastructure that redefines how investment firms across Venture Capital and Private Equity run. We’re building the systems that sit at the heart of fund administration: financial data pipelines, transaction engines, ML-assisted tooling, and full-service automation.

Our teams are multidisciplinary, working closely with product leaders, accountants, data scientists, and ML researchers to take on some of Carta’s most challenging, ambiguous problems. We’re drawn to complexity, motivated by clarity, and operate with a high degree of ownership. If you thrive in early innings problems, enjoy building clean abstractions from messy, real-world scenarios, and want to help shape an industry-standard platform from the ground up, this is the place to do it.

About You

At Carta, you’re not just an employee. You’re a builder who is creating infrastructure that accelerates innovation and empowers more ownership. Cartans are helpful, relentless, unconventional and kind; representing Carta’s Identity Traits. They work collaboratively and cross functionally to challenge the status quo; working towards a common goal of creating more owners in the private markets.

  • You have 6+ years of experience of full-stack or backend engineering experience
  • You have strong technical skills and are an excellent collaborator
  • You act as an owner, not just a contributor, by taking responsibility for outcomes, pushing through ambiguity, and championing solutions that improve team efficiency and business impact.
  • You implement systems that are clear, maintainable, and stand the test of time.
  • You are excited by opportunities to both break ground on new projects and provide fresh perspective onto past implementations.
  • You are eager to move fast, but recognize when to build for the future.

title: Solutions Architect - REMOTO
description:
Job description

A Verity está buscando novos talentos!

Somos uma aceleradora de soluções digitais e buscamosArquiteto de Soluções para fazer parte dessa jornada.

Olha só quais são as experiências e conhecimentos que você precisa ter para acelerar e transformar com a gente:


Main responsibilities

Compreensão e Análise de Negócio:

  • Mapear os domínios funcionais relevantes para o negócio.
  • Definir as capacidades de negócio que cada domínio habilita e como elas contribuem para a geração de valor.
  • Identificar e detalhar os requisitos (funcionais, negócio, dados, conformidade, leis e regulatórios, etc.).
  • Detalhamento dos requisitos não funcionais (desempenho, segurança, escalabilidade, etc.) e definição de métricas claras para cada um.
  • Priorizar os requisitos com base no valor para o negócio e nas restrições técnicas.

Arquitetura e Design da Solução:

  • Escolher padrões e estilos arquiteturais adequados (microsserviços, filas de mensagens, etc.).
  • Explicar o motivo da escolha dos estilos e padrões arquiteturais, considerando os requisitos de negócio, as restrições técnicas e os trade-offs envolvidos.
  • Considerar os trade-offs entre simplicidade e flexibilidade.
  • Definir estratégias claras para lidar com o aumento da carga (escalabilidade).
  • Implementar mecanismos de recuperação de falhas (resiliência).
  • Atender aos requisitos de alta disponibilidade.
  • Definir como os componentes se comunicam (protocolos, formatos de mensagem, etc).
  • Escolher ferramentas e padrões de integração adequados e suas responsabilidades.
  • Implementar autenticação, autorização e criptografia (segurança).
  • Implementar mecanismos de proteção contra ataques (WAF, etc).
  • Selecionar ferramentas e tecnologias adequadas para implementar a arquitetura, considerando aspectos como desempenho, custo, facilidade de uso e integração com outros sistemas.
  • Justificar a escolha de cada ferramenta/tecnologia, demonstrando um entendimento de seus prós e contras.
  • Demonstrar análise de impacto da solução proposta e em diferentes domínios (Dados, Segurança, Infraestrutura, Soluções e Software, etc.).
  • Demonstrar a estimativa de custo da solução proposta.

Documentação e Apresentação:

  • Documentar a arquitetura da solução de forma clara e concisa.
  • Criar diagramas que representam a arquitetura da solução, incluindo os componentes, suas interações e os fluxos de dados.
  • Centralizar documentações (Readme).
  • Descrever possíveis melhorias ou expansões da solução.
  • Demonstrar capacidade de visão e planejamento a longo prazo.
  • Discutir trade-offs e desafios enfrentados durante o desenvolvimento.

Implementação e Operação:

  • Definir métricas de monitoramento para acompanhar o desempenho, a disponibilidade e a segurança da solução.
  • Implementar alertas para detectar problemas e responder rapidamente.
  • Descrever ferramentas e técnicas para coletar, analisar e visualizar as métricas.

Requisitos Diferenciais:

  • Definir os passos para migrar de um sistema de transição para a nova arquitetura (Arquitetura de Transição).
  • Considerar os riscos e desafios da migração.
  • Mapear os principais Riscos e Desafios identificados durante a proposta da solução.
  • Descrever ações mitigatórias para os Riscos e possíveis soluções para os Desafios mapeados.
  • Demonstrar conhecimento sobre as vantagens e desvantagens das tecnologias escolhidas.
  • Demonstrar consciência dos tradeoffs envolvidos em cada decisão de arquitetura.

Requirements and skills

Experiência:

  • Experiência comprovada em projetos de arquitetura de soluções, com foco em integração de sistemas e otimização de processos.
  • Experiência em análise de requisitos de negócios (funcionais e não funcionais) e transformação em soluções técnicas.
  • Experiência com a definição e implementação de padrões arquiteturais (microsserviços, filas de mensagens, etc.).
  • Vivência em ambientes de desenvolvimento ágil.

Conhecimentos Técnicos:

  • Profundo conhecimento de padrões de integração de sistemas (APIs, mensageria, etc.).
  • Sólido conhecimento de arquiteturas orientadas a microsserviços.
  • Familiaridade com diferentes tecnologias e plataformas de desenvolvimento (ex: Java, .NET, Python, Node.js , Cloud, etc.).
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de modelagem (ex: UML).
  • Conhecimento de segurança da informação (autenticação, autorização, criptografia).
  • Conhecimento de monitoramento e observabilidade de sistemas.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de versionamento de código (ex: Git).
  • Conhecimento de estimativa de custos de infraestrutura e licenças.

Habilidades:

  • Excelente capacidade de comunicação e negociação para influenciar stakeholders técnicos e de negócio.
  • Visão sistêmica e capacidade de análise crítica para identificar oportunidades de melhoria em processos e sistemas.
  • Habilidade de traduzir requisitos de negócios em especificações técnicas claras e concisas.
  • Capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas embasadas em dados e em um profundo entendimento dos trade-offs envolvidos.
  • Habilidade de documentar soluções de forma clara e organizada.
  • Capacidade de liderar tecnicamente equipes de desenvolvimento.

Additional information

Aqui nós somos humanos, somos digitais, somos Verity!

Tudo o que fazemos se baseia em nossos 8 POWER PRINCIPLES:

  • Amar tecnologia;
  • Assumir grandes responsabilidades;
  • Cultivar relações de confiança por meio da transparência;
  • Dar atenção e ser orientado pela necessidade e experiência do cliente;
  • Encarar desafios de forma ágil;
  • Colaborar entre pessoas e equipes;
  • Encorajar a autonomia consciente;
  • Atingir resultados de forma consciente.

É assim que criamos experiências inovadoras para o mundo digital, inspirando protagonismo e gerando resultados incríveis aos nossos clientes, sempre focados em metodologia, tecnologia e pessoas.

Fomos certificados comouma das melhores empresas para se trabalhar pelo Great Place To Work, e a cada dia criamos ações que melhoram ainda mais o ambiente de trabalho, aqui na Verity você tem:

  • Vale refeição

  • Convênios em estabelecimentos e instituições de ensino

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
Overview

Xometry (NASDAQ: XMTR) powers the industries of today and tomorrow by connecting the people with big ideas to the manufacturers who can bring them to life. Xometry’s digital marketplace gives manufacturers the critical resources they need to grow their business while also making it easy for buyers at Fortune 1000 companies to tap into global manufacturing capacity.

Xometry is seeking a Senior Data Scientist to join our Data Science team. This person will drive data science initiatives, provide technical guidance when needed, and leverage data to solve complex business challenges. The ideal candidate has a deep understanding of data science methodologies, strong statistical expertise, and proven experience delivering impactful data solutions in a dynamic environment. This is a 1-year contract with the potential for extension.

Responsibilities

  • Use data analysis, visualization, and modeling tools (e.g., Looker, Jupyter Notebooks, Python, Pandas) to drive data-driven business strategies, with a focus on cost prediction for a two-sided marketplace.
  • Design and execute data science projects, including hypothesis development, statistical analysis, and experimentation (e.g., A/B testing) to answer key business questions and validate assumptions.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate business needs into data science solutions and ensure alignment with Xometry’s objectives.
  • Analyze existing algorithms for accuracy and performance, provide recommendations for optimization, and update production code as necessary.
  • Query and extract data from databases (e.g., Snowflake, MongoDB) to support analysis and model development.
  • Implement robust data science methodologies, emphasizing best practices in code reproducibility, version control, and model deployment.
  • Continuously iterate and improve solutions within a fast-paced, agile environment, addressing challenges with innovative, data-driven approaches.
  • Foster a culture of collaboration, teamwork, and continuous learning, encouraging knowledge sharing and skill development within the team.

Qualifications

  • A bachelor’s degree is required; an advanced degree (M.S. or PhD) in applied math, computer science, data science, engineering, or a related field is highly preferred.
  • 5+ years of experience in data science
  • Strong expertise in SQL and Python (numpy, scipy, pandas, and scikit-learn preferred) and experience with API integrations using Python.
  • Proficient in applied statistics, including knowledge of probability distributions, confidence intervals, statistical tests (e.g., t-tests, ANOVA, Chi-Square), and power analysis.
  • Experience with pricing algorithms and technology-driven product development.
  • Knowledge of scientific software principles, including version control, code reproducibility, and deployment practices.
  • Demonstrated ability to work in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment and manage shifting priorities effectively.
  • Must be able to work core hours aligned with US Eastern Time (GMT-5).
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate with global teams and articulate complex technical information to non-technical stakeholders.

Xometry is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status.

For US based roles: Xometry participates in E-Verify and after a job offer is accepted, will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.

description:
Overview

Openstone is a Paris-based private markets asset management company specializing in evergreen funds of funds. We provide our clients with access to a diversified portfolio of private market investments (real estate, private debt, etc.) through a unique and flexible structure. Our innovative approach allows retail investors to benefit from the growth potential of private markets driven by some of the top managers (Ares, BlackRock, Carlyle, EQT...) while maintaining liquidity.

Openstone is a dedicated real estate-based private equity platform that provides financial consulting, advisory and services.

Role Description

We are looking for an experienced and highly motivated Head of International Business Development to lead our global expansion efforts. The successful candidate will be responsible for developing and executing a comprehensive strategy to attract and retain private banks, wealth managers, institutional investors and family offices across key European markets. You will be a key driver of our growth, working hand in hand with the CEO and the leadership team to expand our global footprint and enhance our brand presence.

Key Responsibilities

  • Strategy & Execution: Develop and implement a robust international business development strategy, identifying new markets and opportunities for growth.
  • Investor Relations: Build and maintain strong relationships with a wide range of investors, including private banks, wealth managers, institutional allocators, pension funds, endowments, foundations, and family offices.
  • Sales & Partnerships: Lead all aspects of the sales cycle, from initial outreach to closing, and forge strategic partnerships to expand our distribution channels.
  • Market Analysis: Stay abreast of market trends, competitive landscapes, and regulatory changes to inform our business strategy and product development.
  • Team Leadership: Mentor and manage a growing team of sales development professionals, fostering a high-performance culture.
  • Brand Ambassador: Represent Openstone at industry conferences, roadshows, and events to promote our brand and investment strategies.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in the asset management industry, preferably, but not necessarily, with a focus on private markets.
  • Proven track record in business development, sales, and investor relations, specifically with private banks, wealth managers, institutional and sophisticated investors.
  • Deep understanding of private markets, evergreen funds, and funds of funds.
  • Existing network of relationships with investors and family offices in Europe.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment.

title: YouTube Manager
description:
A Impact Media is on a mission to empower real estate professionals to own their market through media.

At A Impact Media, we hire for impact. If you’re exceptional at what you do and align with our core values—Beyond Excellence, Extreme Ownership, Proactive Curiosity, and Mission Focused—we want to know you.

Role

We are hiring a YouTube Manager for A Impact Media. The YouTube Manager is a strategic and creative leader who translates our clients’ business priorities into long‑form video content, and builds the top real estate channels across the country.

You’re not just managing YouTube channels. You’re leading strategy, storytelling, and systems behind uploads that scale our clients’ local authority to hundreds of thousands of impressions a year on YouTube. You are a multifaceted creative fluent in ideation, production planning, copywriting, post‑production oversight, and YouTube analytics. You’ll work to craft standout content that changes how top agents and teams approach media and market dominance. You will lead production, posting, and packaging direction, distill insights into engaging content, and ensure continuous improvement through analysis and feedback loops. You’ll maintain strategic alignment with key business initiatives and collaborate with YouTube Strategists, Client Success Managers, the creative team, and client teams to shape channel strategy, content production, and distribution.

If the idea of leading and growing YouTube’s top real estate channels excites you, let’s talk.

Responsibilities

  • Team Leadership and YouTube Infrastructure
  • Manage editors, thumbnail designers, and pre‑production team across multiple client accounts
  • Support relevant YouTube scorecard metrics (CTR, retention, view velocity, follower growth) and present insights to leadership and clients
  • Support scalable, documented systems for scripting, packaging, and production handoffs
  • Grow and develop direct reports and members of the YouTube Team
  • Explore and test AI tools to accelerate pre‑ and post‑production workflows; prototype AI‑driven content testing, retention analysis, and scripting support
  • Coordinate with marketing, shorts teams, and external stakeholders for distribution and promotion
  • YouTube Strategy and Channel Architecture
  • Support channel growth strategy with input from clients
  • Balance evergreen local content with timely reactions to market trends and experimental formats
  • Ensure every video educates and reinforces the authors’ authority, credibility, and mission while maintaining each brand’s distinct tone
  • Support the visual identity of packaging and run A/B tests on back catalogue
  • Keep scorecard metrics up to date and share weekly insights with team and clients
  • Pre‑Production
  • Support ideation and research sessions
  • Provide feedback on packaging briefs and video outlines
  • Maintain a four‑to‑six‑week buffer of fully approved topics (outlines, rough thumbnail concepts, title options)
  • Post‑Production
  • Own post‑production timelines and upload calendar
  • Conduct regular retention reviews to improve engagement
  • Collaborate with Senior Editor for retention notes and final approvals
  • Create brand guidelines, SOPs, and artifacts to streamline post‑production
  • Results
  • Support 45‑60+ videos monthly within your team, managing around 5–10 clients
  • 90%+ on‑time delivery rate
  • Client channels achieving 100–1000 subscriber growth monthly
  • Support client revenue goals (generating leads monthly and $7.5–$10M+ in sales per client per year)
  • 50–75% of videos outperform baselines on impressions and subscriber growth
  • Lift in subscriber‑to‑view ratios; higher average views and faster velocity
  • Regular documentation of content experiments and A/B tests
  • Improved use of AI and other tools to increase team leverage
  • Positive client sentiment on brand and growth

Requirements

  • Understanding of the YouTube landscape—concepts, thumbnails, titles, and retention editing
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Analytical fundamentals and ability to work with data
  • 2+ years of relevant experience in YouTube channel development; bonus points for a large educational channel
  • Proficiency with editing notes tools (e.g., Frame.io)
  • Proficiency with project management tools (e.g., Notion)
  • Proficiency with G Suite
  • Knowledge of editing and Photoshop is a plus but not required

Communication Expectations

  • We use Slack as the primary communications tool
  • We value over‑communication and speed in responses
  • Weekly Creative Team Meetings
  • Weekly meetings with Media Manager/Team Leader
  • Weekly meetings with the creative team

Location : Remote (work from home)

Hours : Mon – Fri 9am–6pm EST with flexibility to work weekends when needed

Compensation : $16,800 – $28,800 USD annually with progression from part‑time to full‑time. Highly experienced YouTube strategists can earn $24,000–$36,000 USD per year.

Benefits

  • 30–60 day paid trial period
  • Flexible work arrangements (part‑time to full‑time path)
  • Remote work flexibility
  • Performance‑based advancement opportunities

We raise the bar and pursue mastery; excellence is a moving target.

Extreme Ownership

Curious minds build better things. Question everything and see challenges as opportunities.

title: Tech Lead (Sub-Acquirer)
description:
Come Make an Impact on Millions of Brazilians!

At RecargaPay, we’re on a mission to deliver the best payment experience for Brazilian consumers and small businesses — by building a powerful digital ecosystem where the banked and unbanked connect, and where consumers and merchants have a one-stop shop for all their financial needs.

We serve over 10 million users and process more than USD 4 billion annually. We’ve been profitable since 2022 and operate our own credit business. We are an AI-first, 100% remote team, scaling in the rapidly changing Brazilian financial market.

Our goal? Deliver the best payment experience in Brazil for people and small businesses alike.

We value autonomy, ownership, and a bias for action. We’re looking for people who are curious, hands-on, and driven by impact — who want to solve real problems, work with strong teams, and rethink what’s possible.

If you’re ready to do your best work, at scale, with purpose — this is your place.

Responsibilities

As a Tech Lead, you will play a strategic role, serving as a technical reference and team leader. This position requires a balance between technical expertise, people leadership, and project management.

  • Define team objectives and project goals, ensuring alignment with the company's broader strategies and objectives.
  • Facilitate communication within the squad and across technical and non-technical teams, ensuring alignment and timely delivery of high-quality outcomes.
  • Actively participating in the recruitment, training, and development of team members, fostering a productive and growth-oriented environment.
  • Collaborating with other technical leaders, aligning technology strategies and contributing to the evolution of the company's technical direction.
  • Ensuring the technical quality of deliverables, providing guidance and support in solving complex problems.
  • Promote the adoption of AI-assisted engineering practices within your squad and chapter, leveraging tools for code generation, automated refactoring, test case creation, and technical documentation. Identify opportunities where AI can enhance developer productivity, code quality, and team velocity.
  • Guide conversations to remove blockers and encourage collaboration in your team.
  • Collaborate with the Product Owner to ensure technical initiatives, such as refactoring, performance tuning, and tech debt—are properly scoped and prioritized within the product backlog.
  • Ensure implementation of quality and observability standards, including automated testing, monitoring, alerting, and logging across the development lifecycle.
  • Lead retrospectives and continuous improvement efforts, driving team evolution through feedback and actionable insights.
  • Support team staffing decisions by matching people to tasks based on skills, priorities, and development opportunities.
  • Support the definition and follow-up of individual development goals aligned with team objectives and business priorities.
  • Academic background oriented toward computer science, engineering, or software development disciplines.
  • Proven track record of leading teams and working in product-driven companies.
  • Hands-on experience in backend (Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, PostgreSQL, AWS) and optionally frontend development, with a track record of delivering scalable systems.
  • Experience in Python is a plus.
  • Experience with asynchronous programming.
  • Experience working with domains of medium to high complexity.
  • A solid understanding of how web and mobile applications work including security, session management, and best development practices.
  • Knowledge of relational database systems and Object Oriented Programming.
  • Knowledge of Domain-Driven Design (DDD) and experience designing or maintaining microservices-based systems.
  • Ability to work and thrive in a fast-paced environment, learn rapidly and master diverse web and mobile technologies and techniques.
  • Practical experience applying AI frameworks in development projects.
  • Solid understanding of the software development lifecycle and experience with agile methodologies.
  • Advanced Problem-Solving and Decision-Making Skills.
  • Ability to engage both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Competence in defining clear objectives and ensuring the team meets project milestones.
  • Experience guiding and leading teams to successful project deliveries within deadlines and budgets.
  • Ability to evaluate and prioritize technical work based on business value, system health, and long-term platform goals.
  • Experience conducting code reviews, driving knowledge sharing, and promoting collaborative development practices.
  • Experience building and developing high-performing engineering teams.
  • Active contribution to aligning technological strategies with broader organizational objectives.


Soft Skills

  • Ability to clearly communicate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, facilitating alignment and decision-making.
  • Strong collaboration skills to work effectively with Product Managers, Product Owners, Squad Leaders, Designers, and other teams, tribes or squads in defining priorities and delivering value.
  • Experience mentoring engineers, guiding career development, and fostering a growth-oriented, high-performance team environment.
  • Capacity to make thoughtful, context-aware decisions that balance technical debt, delivery speed, and business impact.
  • Ability to recognize team dynamics, support team members through challenges, and cultivate psychological safety.
  • Proactive in owning outcomes, addressing blockers, and ensuring that the squad delivers on commitments.
  • Comfortable working in changing environments, reprioritizing as needed, and adjusting to new business or technical demands.
  • Skilled in managing disagreements constructively and promoting consensus through dialogue.
  • Capable of influencing product and technical decisions at squad level and beyond, aligning technical initiatives with broader company goals.
  • Oriented toward retrospectives, feedback loops, and implementing process and culture improvements.
  • High degree of autonomy and accountability, with a bias for action and results-oriented problem solving.
  • Comfort operating at both strategic and hands-on levels, flexing between system design and stakeholder engagement as needed.
  • Ability to make decisions based on accurate information, technical indicators, and impact metrics, using data to prioritize initiatives, guide trade-offs, and measure success.


Industry-Specific Knowledge

As a Tech Leader, you bring practical familiarity with one or more core financial domains, such as lending, payments, credit cards, open finance, fraud prevention, merchant acquiring, or investment services, and understand the operational workflows, regulatory considerations, and business impact that shape these areas.

You leverage this knowledge not only to guide the technical implementation of backend solutions, such as payment orchestration, fraud-detection services, or onboarding flows, but also to collaborate with Product Managers, Designers, and business stakeholders in defining priorities and making trade-offs that balance technical feasibility with strategic objectives.

Your role involves translating domain-specific requirements into actionable tasks, mentoring engineers to understand the business context behind their work, and ensuring the team delivers solutions that are robust, compliant, and aligned with customer needs. You help the squad connect technical work with revenue, performance, and user experience outcomes, creating an environment where engineers contribute with full awareness of business impact.

Process Stages

HR Interview
Our first contact will be a casual conversation to learn about you, your career journey, and align expectations. We’ll conduct a brief technical assessment and answer your questions about the role, our culture, and what makes us unique. We want you to get to know us better too! ????
Assessment (skills mapping)
We use an evaluation tool to map your work style and how you align with our culture. This step helps us understand how your skills can enhance our solutions.
Technical Assessment
Now it’s time to showcase your technical talent! In this step, you’ll solve technical cases and have a discussion with our engineering team. We’ll dive into your decisions, strategies, and how you design scalable and robust solutions. Beyond evaluation, we want to exchange ideas and explore how your solutions can impact RecargaPay!

Conversation with Leadership
Here, you’ll meet the squad leader to understand the position’s challenges, discuss the team’s daily activities, and evaluate alignment between our goals, culture, and your career aspirations. This will be an open space to align expectations and ensure RecargaPay is a place where you can grow and make a difference. ????
Offer
If we’ve made it this far together, we’d be thrilled to invite you to join our team! You’ll receive a detailed proposal with all the information about the role, benefits, and the impact you’ll have with us. We can’t wait to welcome you!
Note: There may be an additional step if specific alignments are needed.

  • Competitive and market-aligned salary.
  • Remote work — wherever you are, you’re part of the team!
  • Home office allowance through a monthly deposit in the RecargaPay app.
  • Health and dental plans with no co-pay.
  • Life insurance.
  • Flexible meal allowance (via Flash).
  • TotalPass membership to take care of your health.
  • Spanish or Portuguese classes.

Diversity & Inclusion at RecargaPay
At RecargaPay, you’ll have the freedom to be who you are because we believe that diverse perspectives and experiences make us more creative and stronger. Here, everyone is welcome to express themselves authentically. We value the richness of each journey and the multiple ways of seeing the world, without distinctions of gender, race, sexual orientation, age, religion, or any other characteristic that makes us unique.

About the use of your Data
By sharing your resume with us, you authorize the use of your data for analysis during the selection process and possibly for other opportunities within the RecargaPay group. You can request the update or deletion of your information at any time, in accordance with LGPD (General Data Protection Law).

description:
Overview

Medical Writer - Senior Regulatory Writing Specialist
Location: Remote

Position Summary

The Senior Regulatory Writing Specialist is a professional responsible for the creation of regulatory materials for investigational and marketed products in alignment with regulatory and compliance practices. The individual will work directly with client teams to manage regulatory writing projects.

Essential Functions

  • Regulatory writing skills with mastery of 3 or more regulatory document types (eg, clinical study protocols, clinical study reports, briefing documents, IND, NDA, and MAA components).
  • Solid understanding of and ability to apply the statistical, regulatory, and medical communication concepts needed to independently write regulatory documents in more than 1 therapeutic area. Manages at least 3 single-document projects simultaneously.
  • Working knowledge of relevant regulatory guidance (eg, ICH, FDA, EMA) for clinical trial conduct, including document-specific guidance. Core cross-functional clinical research roles and procedures, and how they relate to document preparation. Acts as a primary writer and/or project manager for key documents and projects.
  • Ensures document accuracy, completeness, and consistency of messaging. Organizes and leads cross-functional document review meetings, clarifies and incorporates feedback, and works with cross-functional subject matter experts to resolve unclear comments and differences of opinion between functional areas.
  • Performs document-level QC (including abbreviations, references to sources, data in text versus data in tables, figures, or graphs) and writer peer review (logical flow, sense check, etc.).
  • Leads project-level management activities, i.e., timeline preparation and oversight and meeting scheduling. Participates in guiding less experienced writers on those documents for which they have expertise.
  • Proactively contributes to improvements to medical writing processes.
  • Understands, complies with, and contributes to the updates of SOPs, templates, best practices, policies, and regulatory writing style guides.
  • Develops project-level lexicons and conventions.

Position Qualifications

Above average attention to detail, teamwork and initiative. Ability to interact with other departments within the company and be proficient in written and verbal communication. Proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel, Power Point and Outlook, and quickly able to learn new software. Ability to apply regulatory guidelines to content development.

Skills and Abilities

Education: Advanced degree in a scientific discipline (e.g., life sciences, pharmacy, medicine) or relevant work experience; or equivalent combination of education, training, and experience.

Experience: More than 2 years (typically 3-5 years) of experience in scientific/medical/regulatory writing in the pharmaceutical domain.

Computer Skills: Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.

Work Environment

Remote - Europe

Location: Remote

About The Role

We are seeking highly qualified professionals with (Master's or PhD) in Medical Microbiology to support the development of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs).

Required Qualifications

  • Master's or PhD in Medical Microbiology, Immunology, or a closely related biomedical discipline.
  • Demonstrated expertise in core areas such as microbial pathogenesis, clinical diagnostics, virology, bacteriology, parasitology, and immunology.
  • Familiarity with laboratory procedures, microbiological instrumentation, and interpretation of diagnostic test results (e.g., blood cultures, PCR, AST).

description:
Join to apply for the Medical Specialist role at Innodata Inc.

Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world's biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine. By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we\'re helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms. Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany.

Job Title: Generative AI Associate Analyst (LLM Training – Medical Domain)

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Flexible Contract Role (Part-time, up to 25 hours weekly)

Overview

We are seeking highly qualified professionals with a Master\u2019s or PhD in Medical Microbiology to support the development of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs). As a Rater / AI Trainer, you will shape how AI understands and communicates complex biomedical knowledge, with a focus on microbiological sciences. This role involves evaluating AI-generated responses for scientific accuracy, contextual integrity, and clinical relevance within medical microbiology. Your feedback and annotations will inform the improvement of AI systems used in healthcare education, diagnostics support, public health communication, and biomedical research.

Key Responsibilities

  • Critically assess AI-generated responses in topics including microbial taxonomy, infectious disease mechanisms, host8pathogen interactions, diagnostic microbiology, antimicrobial resistance, and laboratory methodologies.
  • Apply structured annotation to texts, including labeling for scientific correctness, terminology accuracy, logical structure, and clinical relevance.
  • Categorize model outputs using domain-specific taxonomies (e.g., pathogen type, disease process, diagnostic method).
  • Create real-world clinical or laboratory scenarios with researchers to design and test prompts to assess the model\'s reasoning and adaptability to professional contexts (e.g., interpreting culture reports, recommending diagnostic tests, understanding resistance profiles).

Required Qualifications

  • Master’s or PhD in Medical Microbiology, Immunology, or a closely related biomedical discipline.
  • Demonstrated expertise in core areas such as microbial pathogenesis, clinical diagnostics, virology, bacteriology, parasitology, and immunology.
  • Familiarity with laboratory procedures, microbiological instrumentation, and interpretation of diagnostic test results (e.g., blood cultures, PCR, AST).
  • Excellent written communication skills and fluency in English.
  • As part of the project, you are required to complete the English language assessment (mandatory & non-billable).

title: Homebuying Specialist
description:
Overview

Are you competitive, persuasive, and ready to thrive in a remote sales role that rewards hustle and drive? Neighbors Bank, a leading innovator in the mortgage industry, is looking for ambitious sales professionals who know how to make connections, earn trust quickly, and drive conversations forward.

We\'re not looking for mortgage experts. We\'re looking for self-starters with a proven track record in sales — people who can sell over the phone, adapt quickly, and bring energy to every conversation. If you\'ve excelled in a high-volume sales role or competitive environment, you might be exactly who we need.

Our thriving remote culture isn\'t just a perk — it\'s a reflection of how we see the future of work. We want to empower incredible people to do a great job wherever they are, while enabling flexibility .

As a Homebuying Specialist, you\'ll be the voice that turns interest into action. You\'ll be the first point of contact for clients actively pursuing homeownership, allowing you to focus on what you do best — connecting with people and closing deals — without ever making a single cold call. You\'ll play a vital role in fulfilling our vision of making the dream of homeownership more affordable, accessible, and achievable.

What Makes This Role Exciting?

  • Remote-First with Flexibility: Flourish in a fully remote role with the freedom to structure your day, focus on performance, and rely on tools that support long-term success.
  • Big Rewards for Top Performers: Competitive, uncapped commissions and bonuses await those who excel. Top performers are earning over $50 per hour.
  • Be Part of Something Bigger: Join a fast-growing team with an award-winning culture that\'s been recognized as a Top Workplace in the Financial Services industry while making homeownership achievable for thousands of underserved families.
  • Comprehensive Benefits: Including health and dental coverage, a wellness program, 401(k) matching, PTO, paid holidays, and more.
  • Problem Solvers Wanted: This role is ideal for individuals who tackle challenges and find innovative solutions.

Your Journey at Neighbors Bank

Most Homebuying Specialists earn $65,000-$80,000 annually, with top performers exceeding that range. We provide a comprehensive program to support you in reaching your income goals in remote sales and mortgage origination.

From day one, you\'ll earn a base pay of $20 per hour, plus uncapped performance-based bonuses . While this is a full-time role, your earnings potential is based on your production — not your schedule.

You\'ll also benefit from:

  • A structured onboarding program to help you master the loan origination process.
  • Real-time coaching and support from experienced team leads.
  • The flexibility to build a schedule that works for you.

This is a full-time position where you can expect to work up to 40 hours each week, but we are seeking individuals who can work at least 64 hours each month during the evenings and weekends (or roughly 16 hours per week after 5pm or any time Saturday and Sunday). You will have a high degree of flexibility with when you choose to work each week. Top performers maximize their earnings by leaning into evenings, weekends, and other high-conversion windows.

Our People and Culture

Our People and Culture are our greatest strengths. We\'re seeking individuals who:

  • Are passionate about their job and have fun doing it.
  • Will deliver results with integrity.
  • Enjoy finding ways to enhance the lives of others every day.

Your Role as a Homebuying Specialist

Homebuying Specialists are the first voice our customers hear, and a critical part of turning curiosity into confidence. Our clients seek support from Neighbors Bank, so there is no cold calling required. Your role is to connect quickly, ask the right questions, and guide potential borrowers through the first steps of the home loan process.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build rapport and collect borrower financial and credit information.
  • Educate borrowers on the loan process and identify financing options.
  • Analyze credit, income, and assets to prequalify or deny applications.
  • Provide clear communication with borrowers while guiding them through initial documentation and next steps.
  • Secure documentation and ensure all stages of the loan process are completed efficiently.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Are You the One?

No mortgage experience? No problem — but sales talent, grit, and hustle are a must. We\'re looking for high-performing individuals with a proven ability to connect with people, work independently, and close the deal. Whether you come from a call center, cold-calling environment, or another competitive sales background, success in this role comes down to mindset and motivation.

This role rewards self-starters who can adapt quickly, think on their feet, and bring energy to every conversation. If that sounds like you, read on.

Here\'s what makes a great fit

  • Thrive working remotely and staying self-motivated.
  • Have succeeded in fast-paced or performance-based roles.
  • Bring a strong competitive drive and hunger to earn.
  • Communicate clearly and professionally with customers.
  • Stay focused under pressure and in high-volume settings.
  • College degrees are not required, but the ability to learn quickly is essential.

This isn\'t the role for you if

  • You need frequent oversight to stay on track.
  • You prefer routine tasks over rapid change.
  • You're not comfortable and confident talking to customers on the phone.

Where We\'re Hiring

We\'re actively hiring in the following states: AL, AZ, AR, FL, ID, IA, KS, MS, MO, MT, OK, TX, UT, and VA.

Why Neighbors Bank?

Neighbors Bank is more than just a workplace — it\'s a community. Our mission is to Enhance Lives , and we\'re passionate about doing that through innovative solutions and a culture of collaboration and excellence. If you\'re ready to join a team where your contributions truly matter, we\'d love to hear from you!

The People and the Culture are Neighbors Bank\'s greatest strengths. We seek individuals who are passionate about their job, deliver results with integrity, and enjoy enhancing the lives of others every day.

Neighbors Bank\'s recognition as being a Top Workplace in Financial Services: Top Workplaces.

Neighbors Bank is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workforce. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, religion, color, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, veteran status, or other legally protected classifications.

description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Medical Specialist role at Innodata Inc. From the job posting: Generative AI Associate Analyst (LLM Training – Medical Domain). Location: Remote. Employment Type: Flexible Contract Role (Part-time, up to 25 hours weekly).

We are seeking highly qualified professionals with (Master's or PhD) in Medical Microbiology to support the development of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs). As a Rater / AI Trainer, you will play a critical role in shaping how AI understands and communicates complex biomedical knowledge, with a specific focus on microbiological sciences. This role involves evaluating AI-generated responses for scientific accuracy, contextual integrity, and clinical relevance within the field of medical microbiology. Your feedback and annotations will inform the improvement of AI systems used in healthcare education, diagnostics support, public health communication, and biomedical research.

Key Responsibilities

  • Critically assess AI-generated responses in topics including microbial taxonomy, infectious disease mechanisms, host–pathogen interactions, diagnostic microbiology, antimicrobial resistance, and laboratory methodologies.
  • Apply structured annotation to texts, including labeling for scientific correctness, terminology accuracy, logical structure, and clinical relevance.
  • Categorize model outputs using domain-specific taxonomies (e.g., pathogen type, disease process, diagnostic method).
  • Create real-world clinical or laboratory scenarios with researchers to design and test prompts to assess the model's reasoning and adaptability to professional contexts (e.g., interpreting culture reports, recommending diagnostic tests, understanding resistance profiles).

Required Qualifications

  • Master's or PhD in Medical Microbiology, Immunology, or a closely related biomedical discipline.
  • Demonstrated expertise in core areas such as microbial pathogenesis, clinical diagnostics, virology, bacteriology, parasitology, and immunology.
  • Familiarity with laboratory procedures, microbiological instrumentation, and interpretation of diagnostic test results (e.g., blood cultures, PCR, AST).
  • Excellent written communication skills and fluency in English.
  • As part of the project, you are required to complete the English language assessment. The assessment is mandatory & non-billable.

Join to apply for the Medical Specialist role at Innodata Inc.

Overview

Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world's biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms. Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany.

Job details

Job Title: Generative AI Associate Analyst (LLM Training – Medical Domain)

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Flexible Contract Role (Part-time, up to 25 hours weekly)

About The Role

We are seeking highly qualified professionals with (Master\'s or PhD) in Medical Microbiology to support the development of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs). As a Rater / AI Trainer, you will play a critical role in shaping how AI understands and communicates complex biomedical knowledge, with a specific focus on microbiological sciences. This role involves evaluating AI-generated responses for scientific accuracy, contextual integrity, and clinical relevance within the field of medical microbiology. Your feedback and annotations will inform the improvement of AI systems used in healthcare education, diagnostics support, public health communication, and biomedical research.

Key Responsibilities

  • Critically assess AI-generated responses in topics including microbial taxonomy, infectious disease mechanisms, host–pathogen interactions, diagnostic microbiology, antimicrobial resistance, and laboratory methodologies.
  • Apply structured annotation to texts, including labeling for scientific correctness, terminology accuracy, logical structure, and clinical relevance.
  • Categorize model outputs using domain-specific taxonomies (e.g., pathogen type, disease process, diagnostic method).
  • Create real-world clinical or laboratory scenarios with researchers to design and test prompts to assess the model\'s reasoning and adaptability to professional contexts (e.g., interpreting culture reports, recommending diagnostic tests, understanding resistance profiles).

Required Qualifications

  • Master\'s or PhD in Medical Microbiology, Immunology, or a closely related biomedical discipline.
  • Demonstrated expertise in core areas such as microbial pathogenesis, clinical diagnostics, virology, bacteriology, parasitology, and immunology.
  • Familiarity with laboratory procedures, microbiological instrumentation, and interpretation of diagnostic test results (e.g., blood cultures, PCR, AST).
  • Excellent written communication skills and fluency in English.
